mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

Update: Verified the latest Chasing Immortality Codes on June 01, 2026

Starting out in Chasing Immortality feels slow. You begin as someone with nothing, growing step by step through life stages, trying to survive, train, and eventually reach power that actually matters. That’s exactly where codes help-they don’t break the game, but they remove the early grind and make every rebirth feel worth it.

Here are all the latest working Chasing Immortality codes you can use right now.

All Active Chasing Immortality Codes

  • DELAYS: 1 Heavens Pill (NEW)
  • FINALDEMONIC: 100 Souls Fragments (NEW)
  • NOWAYUPDATE: 250 Souls Fragments (NEW)

These can disappear anytime, so it’s better to redeem them immediately.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Ghoul Incremental Codes, Knockout Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Chasing Immortality Codes

9KLIKES, DEMONIC, LIKETHEGAME2, OPENTEST1, PRAY, RELEASE, SHORTUPDATE, TYFORSUPPORT, UPDATE3, WELOVEKIRIVA, WOWUPDATE

How to Redeem Chasing Immortality Codes

Before you redeem anything, there’s one requirement you cannot skip-you must join the official Roblox group and like the game. Once that’s done, follow these steps:

  1. Launch Chasing Immortality on Roblox.
  2. Select Save File 1.
  3. Open the Misc menu at the top.
  4. Go to the Codes tab.
  5. Enter your code.
  6. Click Submit to claim rewards.

If everything is done correctly, your rewards will be added instantly.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work

If a code fails, it’s usually something small rather than the code itself.

  • You didn’t join the Roblox group or like the game
  • Typing error in the code (copy-paste is safer)
  • Temporary server issues
  • Unstable internet connection

If the code still doesn’t work, rejoin the game or try again after a few minutes.

How to Get More Codes

New codes usually drop without warning, so timing matters.

  • Roblox group (required anyway for redemption)
  • Official Discord server
  • Game update announcements

The easiest way is to bookmark this page and follow along, so you never miss new code drops.

Why These Codes Matter

Chasing Immortality is built around rebirth. Every time you restart, you carry forward progress through Soul Fragments. These are not just basic rewards-they permanently improve your stats, luck, cooldowns, and overall efficiency.

In simple terms, codes speed up your entire progression loop. Instead of grinding multiple lifetimes for small gains, you get a head start that compounds over time.

Along with fragments, you may also get items like Heavens Pills. These can boost things like lifespan or Qi, depending on the type, making your current run stronger and more stable.

Final Thoughts

Chasing Immortality is not about rushing-it’s about steady growth across multiple lives. But without a little boost early on, it can feel slow and repetitive.

These codes fix that. They give you just enough momentum to make each rebirth meaningful, without removing the satisfaction of progress.

Use them early, stack your fragments, and your future runs will feel completely different.

In case you missed:

  • NBA 2K26 Locker Codes
  • Black Grimoire Codes
  • Unbox Your Car Codes

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

Update: Verified the latest Ghoul Incremental Codes on June 01, 2026

If you have spent even a little time in Ghoul Incremental, you already know how slow things can feel at the start. You grind, you wait, and just when things start picking up, you hit a wall. That is exactly where codes come in. They give you that small but crucial push that turns a slow run into real progress.

Instead of hoping for better stats or wasting time rerolling blindly, you can use these codes to get free rerolls for your Kagune, combat style, and multipliers. That means better builds, faster growth, and a much smoother climb toward becoming a powerful ghoul.

All Working Ghoul Incremental Codes

  • LIKES1K: 4 Kagune Rolls, 4 Combat Style Rolls, 4 RG Multiplier Rolls (NEW)
  • PVP: 2 Kagune Rolls, 2 Combat Style Rolls, 2 RG Multiplier Rolls (NEW)
  • RAIDS: 4 Kagune Rolls, 4 Combat Style Rolls, 4 RG Multiplier Rolls
  • SORRYFORBUGS: 1 Kagune Rolls, 1 Combat Style Rolls, 1 RG Multiplier Rolls
  • IMAGHOUL: 1 Kagune Rolls, 1 Combat Style Rolls, 1 RG Multiplier Rolls

These rewards might look small, but in an incremental game, even a single good reroll can completely change your run.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Unbox a Factory Codes, Reign Piece Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Ghoul Incremental Codes

FASTLIKES, LIKES150, LIKES500

How to Redeem Ghoul Incremental Codes

Redeeming codes in Ghoul Incremental is simple and takes just a few seconds.

  1. Open Ghoul Incremental on Roblox.
  2. Click the Gift icon on the screen.
  3. Paste a working code into the text box.
  4. Click Redeem.

If the code is valid, you will instantly receive your rewards.

Why These Codes Matter

Ghoul Incremental is not just about clicking and waiting. It is about smart progression. You collect Blood, unlock upgrades, and eventually hit a point where progress slows down heavily. That is when systems like rerolls and multipliers become important.

  • Kagune Rolls help you get stronger abilities
  • Combat Style Rolls improve how you fight
  • RG Multipliers boost your overall growth speed

Using codes at the right time can save hours of grinding and help you push past difficult stages.

Understanding Progression in Ghoul Incremental

At its core, the game is a classic incremental experience inspired by Tokyo Ghoul. You collect Blood, spend it on upgrades, and repeat the cycle. Eventually, you will reach a point where progress slows down significantly. This is where the prestige system comes in.

  • You reset your progress
  • You earn RC Cells
  • You unlock permanent upgrades

These upgrades stay with you even after future resets, making each run faster than the last.

As you go deeper, you also unlock Automation, which lets the game handle upgrades for you. This is essential for idle play and makes repeated runs much easier.

Common Issues When Codes Do Not Work

If a code is not working, it is usually not a bug. Most of the time, it is one of these reasons:

  • The code has expired
  • You entered the code incorrectly
  • Your server is outdated
  • Your internet connection is unstable

The easiest fix is to copy and paste the code directly and, if needed, rejoin a new server.

How to Get More Ghoul Incremental Codes

The easiest way to stay updated is to keep checking a reliable list instead of searching manually. You can also:

  • Join the official Discord server
  • Follow the Roblox community page

But honestly, the fastest way is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. New codes usually drop with updates, fixes, or milestones.

What Is Ghoul Incremental?

Ghoul Incremental is a text-based Roblox game where you grow stronger by collecting resources and upgrading your abilities over time. The goal is simple but addictive.

You hunt, evolve, and push through layers of progression until you become powerful enough to dominate the game. The loop is repetitive, but that is what makes it satisfying. Every reset feels stronger than the last, and every upgrade feels earned.

If you play it right and use codes smartly, the grind becomes a lot more rewarding and far less frustrating.

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

Update: Verified the latest Unbox a Factory Codes on June 01, 2026

Starting in Unbox a Factory feels simple at first. You open a crate, place a factory, and watch the cash roll in. But very quickly, you realize progress slows down unless you scale smart. That is where codes step in. They give you a small but meaningful push that helps you move faster without waiting.

These codes are not just freebies. They directly impact how quickly you grow your factory network, unlock upgrades, and reach automation.

All Active Unbox a Factory Codes

  • ThanksPlain: 3 Enchanted Crate (NEW)
  • Welcome: 200 Cash and 1 Cash Potion 2 (NEW)
  • 100likes: 200 Cash (NEW)
  • 1klikes: 200 Cash (NEW)

Rewards may slightly vary depending on updates, but all of them help you progress faster by giving instant resources.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Sailor Piece Codes, Be a Lucky Block Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Unbox a Factory Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Unbox a Factory Codes

Redeeming codes is quick and does not interrupt your gameplay. You can do it in seconds once you know where to look.

  1. Open Unbox a Factory in Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings or cogwheel icon in the bottom right.
  3. Find and open the Codes section.
  4. Enter your code exactly as shown.
  5. Click Claim to receive your rewards.

If a code does not work, double check spelling or try copying and pasting instead of typing.

What Unbox a Factory Is Actually About

Unbox a Factory takes a simple idea and stretches it into a satisfying loop. You open crates, get factories, and place them on your plot. Each factory generates cash over time, even when you are offline.

Visitors come in, money builds up, and you slowly expand. As you progress, you unlock better crates, stronger factories, and systems that reduce manual work.

Why Codes Matter More Than You Think

At the start, everything feels fast. But once you reach mid-game, upgrades cost more and progress slows down. This is where codes help.

They give you:

  • Extra cash to open more crates instantly
  • Potions that boost your earnings
  • Better crates that improve your factory quality

That small boost can save hours of waiting. It helps you move from manual collecting to automation much quicker.

Automation, Workers, and Scaling Faster

The real goal is not just placing factories. It is building a system that runs itself. You can unlock features like:

  • Workers that automate your factories
  • Automatic dispensers that streamline production
  • Upgrades that increase output over time

Codes help you reach this stage earlier, which is where the game becomes more satisfying.

How to Get More Codes

New codes usually drop when the game hits milestones like likes or updates. The easiest way to stay updated is to keep checking pages like this one. You can also:

  • Join the official Habit Games Roblox group
  • Join their Discord server

Still, the fastest way is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update the list as soon as new codes go live.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work?

If your code is not working, it usually comes down to two things.

  • The code has expired
  • There is a typo or incorrect capitalization

Always enter codes exactly as shown. Even small mistakes can cause them to fail.

Final Thought

Unbox a Factory is about turning a single crate into a full system that prints money while you do nothing. Codes simply speed up that journey. Use them early, use them fast, and focus on building a setup that can run on its own. That is where the game really starts to feel rewarding.

  • Ghoul Incremental Codes

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

Update: Verified the latest Be a Lucky Block Codes on June 01, 2026

If you have spent even a few minutes in Be a Lucky Block, you already know one thing. luck decides everything. One second you are just another block, the next you pull a rare Brainrot and suddenly your income shoots up. That’s exactly where codes come in. They give you a small push, but in a game built on RNG, that push matters more than it should.

Below is the latest list of working Be a Lucky Block codes, along with how to redeem them and why they are actually worth using.

All Active Be a Lucky Block Codes

  • RADIOACTIVE: 150x Honeycomb (NEW)
  • BEE: 100x Honeycomb (NEW)
  • DinoByte: Free Coins (NEW)
  • CORALUKE: x35 Coralluke Spin Coins
  • BIRD: x30 Luminous Spin Coins
  • M2ZF4KYR: 2x Secret Block
  • EASTER: 35x Free Coins
  • FIX31: 100x Easter Eggs
  • GOD: Get a Free Brainrot
  • DEVIL: 10 Luminous Spin Coins
  • ZEUS: Angelzini Bananini Brainrot
  • RELEASE: Brr Brr Patapim Brainrot
  • R5M93: x50 Spin Coins
  • TR9MP1238: 2 Bunny Block 2 La Everything Block
  • MAGIA: Ta Ta Ta Ta Sahur

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Sailor Piece Codes, Type Soul Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Be a Lucky Block Codes

R81KM461

How to Redeem Be a Lucky Block Codes

Redeeming codes here is simple, and you only need a few clicks. The game keeps it straightforward.

  1. Launch Be a Lucky Block on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop icon on the side of the screen.
  3. Open the Codes tab.
  4. Paste the code into the text box.
  5. Click Verify to claim rewards.

If nothing happens, double-check spelling or try switching servers.

What Be a Lucky Block Is Actually About

At its core, Be a Lucky Block is an RNG simulator where you don’t control outcomes directly , you influence them.

You step onto a ramp, get turned into a lucky block, and the system places you into a base. Once opened, you transform into a random Brainrot. Some are common, some are absurdly rare, and the difference between them is your entire progression.

The goal is simple:

  • Get better Brainrots
  • Increase income per second
  • Upgrade into rarer blocks

But getting there is not simple at all. That’s where codes and strategy start to matter.

How to Get Secret Lucky Blocks

Secret blocks are the real endgame. They are rare, hard to get, and worth the grind.

You can get them through:

  • Luck rolls: Extremely low chance from normal openings
  • Red Carpet: Premium area with better spawn chances
  • Limited-time events: Mini-games like Escape Tsunami or Jailbreak
  • Trading: Swap items with other players

Codes sometimes help indirectly by improving your starting point, which increases your odds over time.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work

If a code fails, it is usually not the code itself.

  • Typo in the code (most common issue)
  • Server or network problems
  • Expired code (not the case right now)

Best way to avoid issues is to copy-paste directly and try again after rejoining.

How to Get More Be a Lucky Block Codes

New codes usually drop during updates, events, or milestones.

You can find them from:

  • Official Discord server
  • X (Twitter) account of the developers
  • YouTube channel updates

Bookmark this page and we will keep the codes updated so you do not have to hunt for them every time.

Should You Even Care About Codes?

Yes, especially early on. Be a Lucky Block is a game where progress is slow unless luck is on your side. Codes give you controlled luck. Not guaranteed wins, but enough of a boost to make a difference.

If you are playing seriously, skipping codes is just slowing yourself down for no reason.

Explore More

  • Chasing Immortality Codes
  • Unbox a Factory Code
  • Ghoul Incremental Codes

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

How To Redeem Sailor Piece Codes

Redeeming codes is simple once you know where to look. The option is slightly hidden in the settings menu, so most new players miss it at first.

Before you redeem, keep this in mind: many codes in Sailor Piece have level requirements. Some work early, but many are locked behind high levels like 2,000, 6,000, or even 10,000. If a code does not work, you might just not be at the required level yet.

  1. Launch Sailor Piece on Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings icon on the left side.
  3. Scroll down to the bottom of the menu.
  4. Enter your code in the “A Secret Code…” box.
  5. Click Redeem.

Your rewards are applied instantly.

What These Codes Actually Give You

At a glance, the rewards look like random items. But in Sailor Piece, almost everything ties back to progression.

  • Beli helps you buy weapons and items across islands
  • Gems unlock features and improve your chances at better abilities
  • Clan, race, and trait rerolls let you fix or optimize your build
  • Shards push your stats further
  • Chests and crates give extra resources and customization

This is why codes matter. They are not just freebies. They reduce bad RNG and save hours of grinding.

Why Your Codes Are Not Working

If a code fails, it usually comes down to a few common reasons.

  • The code has expired
  • You have not reached the required level yet
  • There is a typing mistake
  • You already used the code

Codes are case-sensitive, so copying them directly is the safest way.

Also, some codes may briefly work only in private servers before going live everywhere. Since private servers are free, it can be worth trying there.

When New Codes Are Released

Sailor Piece developers usually drop new codes during key moments in the game.

  • Major updates
  • Milestones like likes or visits
  • Server issues or restarts

Most of these are shared on the official Discord, but they are not always easy to track. Bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update the list as soon as new codes drop.

What Sailor Piece Is About

Sailor Piece is a bandit-beater Roblox RPG inspired by One Piece. You level up by fighting enemies, unlocking fruits, and improving your build through rerolls and upgrades. The loop is simple. Fight, upgrade, repeat.

Codes just make that loop faster and less frustrating, especially once you start pushing into higher levels.

Update: Verified the latest Bizarre Lineage Codes on June 01, 2026

If you just started playing Bizarre Lineage, you will feel it immediately. The game throws you into fights, raids, and builds where small upgrades make a big difference. Getting stronger early is not just about grinding. It is about using every free boost you can get. That is exactly where these codes come in.

They give you useful items like Stand Stat Point Essences, which directly affect how your build performs. Whether you are still figuring out your first Stand or trying to fine-tune a stronger setup, these rewards save time and help you progress faster.

All working Bizarre Lineage codes

  • !code Delay1: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code Delay2: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code Delay3: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code Update1: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code BizarreLineage1: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code LikeTheGameForMore1: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code FavoriteTheGame1: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code Update2=2027: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code 250kLikes: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code 500kLikes: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • !code 750LikesforNextCode: Free Rewards (NEW)

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Clover Retribution Codes, Survive the Knockout Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Bizarre Lineage codes

!CODE 100KLIKES, !CODE 1WEEK, !CODE 30KLIKES, !CODE SHUTDOWNWOOPS

What these codes actually give you

Bizarre Lineage is built around your character’s build. Your Stand, your stats, and your sub abilities all work together. The items from the codes directly feed into this system.

Most of these codes give Stand Stat Point Essences. These let you adjust or improve your stats based on the build you are aiming for. If you choose the wrong stats early, your damage or survivability can fall off quickly. These rewards help fix that without needing to grind again.

Depending on future updates, codes can also include things like cash, chests, or stat resets. All of these are designed to reduce friction and help you experiment with different playstyles.

How to redeem Bizarre Lineage codes

Redeeming codes is simple once you know where to look.

  1. Open Bizarre Lineage on Roblox.
  2. Open the chat box in the game.
  3. Type the code exactly as shown.
  4. Press Enter to claim your rewards.

Some players miss this because there is no separate code menu. Everything happens directly through chat.

In some cases, you may also need to like the game or join the community group before codes work properly.

Why your code might not work

If a code does not work, it is usually something small.

  • The game just updated and servers need a moment to stabilize
  • The code was typed incorrectly or has wrong casing
  • The code expired
  • You have not joined the required Roblox group

Copy and paste is the easiest way to avoid mistakes. If it still fails, restarting Roblox usually fixes temporary issues.

How to get more Bizarre Lineage codes

Codes usually drop through the official Discord server, especially in announcement channels. The problem is that they are easy to miss.

Most players end up spending more time searching for codes than actually playing. Bookmark our page and we will keep the codes updated with the latest ones, so you never miss new drops.

What Bizarre Lineage is and why codes matter

Bizarre Lineage is a Roblox RPG inspired by JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure. You build your character, unlock Stand abilities, and fight through PvE and PvP content.

The game also includes sub abilities like Hamon, Cyborg, Vampire, and Spin. Each one changes how your character plays. Some focus on raw strength, while others give you ranged or healing advantages.

Because the game is heavily build based, small stat changes matter more than they seem. That is why these codes are useful. They are not just freebies. They directly impact how your character performs in fights and raids.

If you are starting out, these codes give you a cleaner path. If you are already progressing, they give you room to experiment without wasting resources.

That is what makes them worth using every time new ones drop.

In case you missed:

  • Sailor Piece Codes
  • Be a Lucky Block Codes
  • Go Catch Codes
  • Ghoul Incremental Codes

Update: Verified the latest Sorcerer Incremental Codes on June 01, 2026

If you have been playing Sorcerer Incremental for even a short time, you already know how grind-heavy the game can feel. You keep clicking, rolling, and progressing slowly, hoping to unlock something powerful. That is exactly where codes step inthey give you a shortcut, a small push that makes the journey smoother and a lot more fun.

In a game built around repetition and steady growth, even a few extra rolls or resources can completely change your progress. So if you are serious about getting stronger faster, these codes are not optional; they are essential.

All Active Sorcerer Incremental Codes

  • BUGFIX: 200x Technique Roll, 3x Sukuna’s Finger, 40x Energy Scroll, 40x Clan Scroll, 150x Weapon Roll (NEW)
  • BALANCE: 125x Technique Roll, 2x Sukuna’s Finger, 35x Energy Scroll, 40x Clan Scroll, 100x Weapon Roll (NEW)
  • AP: 75x Technique Roll, 1x Sukuna’s Finger, 30x Energy Scroll, 30x Clan Scroll, 75x Weapon Roll (NEW)

Each of these codes usually gives you a mix of useful resources like technique rolls, clan rolls, weapon rolls, ally rolls, energy scrolls, and sometimes even rare items like Sukuna Fingers. These are all things you would otherwise need to grind for.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Evil Plate Game Codes, Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Sorcerer Incremental Codes

2000LIKES, 3000LIKES, 4000LIKES, 5500LIKES, ADAPTATION, BIGRAGA, BINDINGVOWS, BOUNDLESSCE, CALAMITY, CALAMITYYUTA, CLANTREE, COMEDIAN, COPYMASTERED, DELAY, DELAYOOPS, DELAYYY, DOMAIN, EASTERBUNNY, EGGHUNT, EVOLUTION, FIXEDGAME, GANGBOSS, GANGWARS, GULLIBLE, HEIANKUNA, HOMELESS, HONOREDONE, INVENTORYCURSE, KINGOFCURSES, LARPER, LIMITLESS, MAHORAGA, MASTERED, MEGADELAY, MEGADELAY1, MEGADELAY2, MEGADELAY3, MINIUPDATE, NEWERA, NEWGOJOHONORED, NEWHONORED, NEWMYTHICALNAOYA, POLYMATH, PRESTIGE, PROJECTIONHAX, QUEENOFCURSES, ROGUELIKE, SEASON3FINALE, SIXEYES, SORRYFORWAIT, SPRINGTIME, SRY4DELAY, STRATEGY, TENSHADOWS, THANKYOU, TOJIWORM, TRUEDOMAIN, TRUEMUTUALLOVE, YUGOAT, ZENINCLAN

How to Redeem Sorcerer Incremental Codes

Redeeming codes in Sorcerer Incremental is simple and takes just a few seconds. Before that, make sure you have joined the official Roblox group for the game, as some codes may not work without it.

  1. Open Sorcerer Incremental on Roblox.
  2. Look for the Codes button (usually at the top-right of the screen).
  3. Click on it to open the code menu.
  4. Enter your code exactly as shown.
  5. Press redeem and claim your rewards.

If the code is valid, your rewards will be added instantly. If not, double-check the spelling or try another code.

What Do These Codes Actually Give You?

This is where things get interesting. Sorcerer Incremental is built around rerolls and progression loops. You keep resetting, rolling, and improving your character step by step.

Codes directly feed into this system by giving you:

  • Technique Rolls: Unlock stronger abilities
  • Clan Rolls: Improve your base traits
  • Weapon Rolls: Get better combat tools
  • Ally Rolls: Strengthen your support system
  • Energy Scrolls: Boost progression speed
  • Sukuna Fingers: Rare and powerful upgrades

Instead of waiting hours to earn these, codes give them to you instantly. That is why using them early can make a huge difference in how fast you grow.

Why Codes Matter So Much in This Game

Sorcerer Incremental is not just about playing it is about optimizing. Every reset, every roll, every upgrade matters. Without extra resources, progress can feel slow and repetitive.

Codes act like a head start. They reduce the grind, help you experiment with builds, and make the game feel more rewarding instead of exhausting.

If you are someone who enjoys seeing progress quickly and trying different strategies, these codes are one of the best tools you have.

How to Get More Codes

New codes usually show up during updates, milestones, and events, but there is no fixed timing. The safest way is to follow the official places where the developers actually post them.

  • Blumea Productions Roblox group (required for some codes to work)
  • Sorcerer Incremental Discord server (fastest updates)
  • Official Trello (useful for understanding weapons, techniques, and systems)

Codes can expire without notice, so checking these regularly helps. If you do not want to track everything yourself, just bookmark this page. We keep it updated and tested so you always have the latest working codes.

Final Thoughts

Sorcerer Incremental is designed to be a slow, steady climb. That is part of its charm, but it can also feel frustrating at times. Codes help balance that experience. They give you just enough boost to keep things exciting without breaking the game.

If you want to progress faster, unlock better abilities, and enjoy the game without unnecessary grind, make sure you use every active code available. It is one of the simplest ways to improve your experience instantly.

In case you missed:

  • Diesel n Steel Codes
  • Summon Heroes Codes
  • Survive the Apocalypse codes

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

Update: Verified the latest Mashle Academy Codes on June 01, 2026

Mashle Academy finally brings the world of Mashle: Magic and Muscles into Roblox, and it lands exactly how fans would expect. You are thrown into a world where magic decides everything, unless you are strong enough to break that rule. Getting stronger takes time, but codes give you a quick push when you need it most.

These Mashle Academy codes give you free rewards like gold, silver, magic rolls, and even rerolls. If you are trying to build a better loadout or recover from a bad start, these freebies make a real difference.

All Working Mashle Academy Codes

  • WEAPONSWAP: 240 Gold Coins (NEW)
  • FPSINPUTS: 240 Gold Coins
  • Subscribe_AttackOnDevs: Free Rewards

All codes are currently working, but that can change anytime. Roblox codes expire without warning, so it is better to redeem them as soon as possible.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Meta Lock Codes, My Dragon Island Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Mashle Academy Codes

AVATARBUGFIX, BLESS, CLEAR, COMPENSATION, DELAYEDUPDATE, DETENTIONRESTORE, EASTEREVENT, EIDMUBARAK, FIXAGAIN, FIXFIXFIX, ISSUES1, ISSUES2, NEWBUILD, NEWSTATS, PARTTWOLATER, PLAYGAMELEGIT, RANKEDCLIMB, RELEASE, STARTER, SUBSCRIBE_ARICKUU, SUBSCRIBE_DARIUSVIBEZ, SUBSCRIBE_ITSVAMPREX, SUBSCRIBE_PXLSWIFT, SUBSCRIBE_REVOLVERAGZ, SUBSCRIBE_UNIVERSALPANTHER, SUBSCRIBE_YODOMM, WAVE2, WEEKENDOVER

How to Redeem Mashle Academy Codes

Before redeeming codes, you need to complete the tutorial. This unlocks the core parts of the game and lets you access the NPC required for redemption.

Once that is done, follow these steps:

  1. Launch Mashle Academy on Roblox.
  2. Go to the Academy Assistant NPC inside the dorms.
  3. Press E to interact.
  4. Enter a working code.
  5. Press Enter to claim rewards.

Rewards are applied instantly, so you can use them right away to improve your build.

Why Codes Matter in Mashle Academy

Mashle Academy is not just another anime RPG where you grind endlessly without direction. Your progress depends heavily on your magic, gear, and overall build. If your rolls are bad early on, it can slow everything down.

This is where codes help. They give you extra rolls, currency, and sometimes even reset options. That means you can fix mistakes, try new builds, or just move faster without wasting hours.

If you have ever felt stuck with a weak setup, these rewards are the easiest way out.

How to Get More Mashle Academy Codes

New codes usually drop during updates, bug fixes, or milestones. The developers also share them through official channels like Discord and Roblox groups. You can also check the developer’s Trello board.

However, tracking all of that manually is not practical. The easiest way is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. The list is updated whenever new codes are released and old ones stop working.

Why Your Mashle Academy Codes Are Not Working

If a code does not work, there are a few common reasons:

  • You are on an outdated server
  • The code has already been used on your account
  • There is a typo in the code

Mashle Academy codes are account-based. This means once you use a code, you cannot reuse it on another slot. If you switch characters, the rewards will not be available again.

If nothing works, try joining a new server and entering the code again.

What is Mashle Academy?

Mashle Academy is a Roblox RPG inspired by Mashle: Magic and Muscles. It blends magic systems with melee combat, letting you build your character around different playstyles.

You can learn magic, switch styles, fight enemies, and take on bosses while progressing through a competitive world where strength and strategy both matter.

The game is currently designed mainly for PC. Console players can join, but they will need a keyboard and mouse for proper controls.

If you are serious about progressing faster or fixing your build, these codes are worth using. They save time, reduce grind, and give you more freedom to experiment with your playstyle.

In case you missed:

  • Be a Lucky Block Codes
  • Bizarre Lineage codes
  • Go Catch Codes

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

Update: Verified the latest Survive the Apocalypse Codes on June 01, 2026

Survive the Apocalypse drops you into a world where every run feels like it could be your last. You start with almost nothing, surrounded by zombies, and everything depends on how well you explore, gather resources, and upgrade over time. That is where codes quietly make a real difference. They give you free Emeralds, and early on, that can completely change how long you last.

All Working Survive the Apocalypse codes

  • forest: 25 Emeralds (NEW)
  • newclasses: 25 Emeralds (NEW)

Emeralds are one of the most important resources in the game. You use them to unlock classes, roll for upgrades, and improve your chances in later waves where enemies get harder and more aggressive.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Evil Plate Game Codes, Roblox Subterra Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired codes

survivor, release

How to redeem codes in Survive the Apocalypse

Redeeming codes is simple once you know where to look, but it is slightly hidden if you are new.

  1. Launch Survive the Apocalypse in Roblox.
  2. Click the Emeralds button on the left side.
  3. Press the Codes button in the menu.
  4. Enter a working code in the box.
  5. Click Claim to get your rewards.

If the code works, the Emeralds will be added instantly to your account.

Why your codes may not work

If a code is not working, it usually comes down to a few common reasons.

  • The code has expired
  • There is a typo or incorrect capitalization
  • The game server has not synced after an update

If everything looks correct, try restarting the game or joining a different server.

How to get more Survive the Apocalypse codes

100MILLION, BIRTHDAY, BLOODHARVEST, LAZYSLYGEMS, MILITARY, MILITARYTWO, ONEMILLION, QUEST, RELEASE, SURVIVOR, TENMILLION, TWOMONTHS, WEAPONUPGRADE

Why these codes actually matter

At first, Survive the Apocalypse feels like a simple survival loop. You explore, fight zombies, collect loot, and try to last longer each run. But as the days progress, difficulty ramps up quickly, and small advantages start to matter.

From what I have seen, Emeralds are where the real progression happens. They let you unlock better classes and upgrades that directly impact your survivability. Without them, you are mostly relying on luck and basic gear.

Using codes early gives you a small but meaningful head start. It does not make the game easy, but it makes your early runs feel less punishing and more rewarding.

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

Update: Verified the latest Spin a Soccer Card Codes on June 04, 2026

If you enjoy collecting football cards, opening packs, and building something that keeps earning even when you are offline, Spin a Soccer Card on Roblox fits perfectly. The game blends simple mechanics with a satisfying loop: spin, unlock cards, place them on your plot, earn money, and repeat. What makes the experience even better is using codes, which give you a head start without the usual grind.

Below is everything you need to know, including the latest working codes, how to redeem them, and why they sometimes fail.

All Working Spin a Soccer Card Codes

  • nethercards: 25 Tournament Tokens, 2 Wish Tickets, 50 Gems, 1 Spin (NEW)
  • OMEGA-STAR: 2 packs and 3 spins (NEW)
  • WOLF-METEOR: Packs (2x your Rebirth level) 3 Spins (min rebirth lvl 2 required)

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Blue Lock Rivals Codes, BLR Legacy Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Spin a Soccer Card Codes

APRILDAY1, APRILDAY2, APRILDAY3, CHAMP-CRYSTAL, CHAMP-LEGEND, CHAMP-MOON, CRYSTAL-GOAL, EXCLUSIVECARDS, GOLDEN-BRONZE, GOLDEN-SHADOW, LETS0TRADE!, LETS1SPIN, LETS8TRADE!, LETSWISH, MOON-STRIKER, MYTHIC-CRYSTAL, RAVEN-OMEGA, RELEASE, RUBY-PRIME, TIGER-HAWK, TIGER-MEGA, TIGER-METEOR, TOURNAMENT, TOURNAMENT67, TRADEUPDATE, W0UPDATE, WOWNEWUPDATE11

How to Redeem Spin a Soccer Card Codes

Before redeeming, make sure you join the official Pixellar Studios Roblox group. Some players may also need to complete basic progress, like tutorial or rebirth requirements.

Follow these steps:

  1. Launch Spin a Soccer Card on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the game to fully load.
  3. Click the Shop icon on the left side.
  4. Scroll down to find the Code section.
  5. Enter your code in the text box.
  6. Click Redeem.

Once redeemed, your rewards are added instantly.

Why These Codes Matter

Spin a Soccer Card is built around progression through packs and randomness. Normally, you earn money slowly by placing cards on your plot and reinvesting into new packs. Codes break this cycle early.

They give you free spins, packs, and sometimes large amounts of cash, letting you jump straight into better rewards. This is especially useful for new players trying to build a strong collection quickly.

Why Codes Might Not Work

If a code fails, it usually comes down to a few simple reasons:

  • Typing mistakes: Codes are case-sensitive, so even a small error breaks them
  • Server delay: New codes sometimes need a moment after updates
  • Expired codes: Many codes are time-limited and stop working without notice
  • Missing requirements: Some codes require joining the group or progressing in the game

The safest approach is to copy and paste codes exactly as listed.

How to Get More Codes

New codes are typically released during updates, events, or milestones. Developers usually share them through:

  • Official Pixellar Studios Roblox group
  • Discord server (#codes channel)

Since codes can expire quickly, checking regularly is important. Redeem them as soon as possible to avoid missing out.

You can also bookmark this page and check back often. We track new codes as soon as they drop and keep this list updated so you never miss free rewards.

Final Thoughts

Spin a Soccer Card works because it keeps things simple but rewarding. You open packs, chase rare players, and slowly turn your plot into a money-generating system. Codes accelerate that journey, giving you instant access to better cards and faster growth.

If you are just starting out, using codes early makes a noticeable difference. Instead of grinding for your first decent pack, you jump straight into the fun part of the game — collecting, upgrading, and building a stronger lineup.

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

title.rendered: Instagram Plus is coming: New features, price, and everything we know so far

content.rendered:
Meta is currently testing a new subscription called Instagram Plus, a premium tier that unlocks exclusive Story tools, advanced privacy controls, audience management features, and enhanced engagement insights. It’s like Instagram wants power users to pay for convenience, better experiences, more control, and premium tools.

And honestly, that’s the most interesting part. Instead of relying entirely on advertising revenue, Meta is approaching a subscription strategy with Facebook Plus, WhatsApp Plus, and Instagram Plus.

If you are curious about the new Instagram Plus subscription, here’s everything you need to know, including its features, eligibility, pricing, and availability.

What is Instagram Plus?

Instagram Plus is a new premium subscription currently being tested by Meta in select markets. After launching Instants, think of it as Instagram’s answer to Snapchat Plus. It gives subscribers access to tools that make Stories more useful, private, and customizable.

For heavy Instagram users, these upgrades may feel genuinely useful. For casual users, they may feel completely unnecessary. That’s probably exactly how Meta wants it.

Instagram Plus vs Meta Verified

A lot of users are confusing Instagram Plus with Meta Verified, but they serve very different purposes.

Meta Verified is all about identity verification. The subscription comes with a verified badge, account protection, and customer service access. Instagram Plus focuses on platform features.

In simple terms, Meta Verified helps prove who you are. Instagram Plus helps you do more on Instagram.

Instagram Plus subscription price: How much will it cost?

Meta has not officially announced global pricing, but testing data gives us a fairly good idea. Current trial pricing in some regions suggests Instagram Plus will be positioned as a low-cost subscription rather than a premium service. As per a TechCrunch report, pricing could be $3.99/month.

That pricing strategy makes sense. Meta is expected to keep the other app subscriptions, like WhatsApp Plus and Facebook Plus, around $3 to $4 as well. This indicates the company only wants millions of users to justify paying a few dollars every month.

If this turns out to be true, many users may subscribe simply for one feature alone: anonymous Story viewing.

Instagram Plus features: Everything available so far

The most interesting thing about Instagram Plus is that almost every feature revolves around Stories. That’s probably not a coincidence. Stories have become one of Instagram’s most-used formats, and Meta appears to be turning them into a premium experience.

1. Anonymous Story previews

This is likely the feature generating the most attention. Instagram Plus allows users to preview Stories without appearing in the viewer list.

For years, users have relied on third-party apps and questionable workarounds to do this. Instagram Plus appears to bring the feature directly into the platform.

2. Extend Stories up to 48 hours

Typically, Instagram Stories expire after 24 hours. With Instagram Plus, users may extend Story visibility to 48 hours.

It’s great news for creators, brands, and businesses as they may generate more views and interaction without reposting the same content again and again.

3. Story rewatch insights

We can already check Instagram Story statistics. Now, the Plus subscribers will receive even more information. They may get to see when people rewatch certain Stories.

This creates a new layer of engagement tracking. A Story that gets viewed twice might be more valuable than one viewed once by twice as many people.

4. Searchable Story viewer list

Anyone who receives thousands of Story views understands the pain of scrolling endlessly through viewer lists.

Instagram Plus introduces search functionality for Story viewers. It’s a small upgrade, but one that creators and business users will likely appreciate.

5. Unlimited Story audience lists

Currently, we rely on Close Friends. Instagram Plus will make a great leap from there, allowing the subscribers to create audience groups and determine exactly whom their Stories will be visible to.

Imagine having separate Story lists for:

  • Family
  • Close friends
  • Work colleagues
  • Customers
  • VIP followers

It’s a simple idea, but one that dramatically improves audience control.

6. Story Spotlight feature

One of the more mysterious additions is Story Spotlight. Based on early testing information, this feature appears designed to increase Story visibility and reach.

Meta hasn’t fully explained how it works, but it could function as a lightweight promotion tool that helps selected Stories gain additional exposure.

7. Super Hearts and Premium reactions

Instagram Plus also introduces enhanced reactions. These include exclusive reactions with special effects and premium engagement options that help interactions stand out.

The feature sounds minor on paper, but social platforms have repeatedly shown that users enjoy exclusive digital status symbols. Just look at Snapchat Plus, Discord Nitro, and Telegram Premium.

Hidden changes most people are missing

Most coverage focuses on the features. The real story is what these features reveal about Instagram’s future.

  • For years, Instagram has been supported almost entirely by advertising. But now it’s quietly becoming a subscription platform. If Instagram Plus succeeds, don’t be surprised if additional paid tiers appear in the future.
  • Stories are becoming Instagram’s most valuable product. That tells us where Meta believes user attention is heading.
  • This could be the beginning of a larger subscription ecosystem. Meta’s head of product, Naomi Gleit, discussed new Meta One plans for AI users, creators, and businesses.

Which countries have Instagram Plus right now?

Instagram Plus is currently available only in limited testing markets.

Reports suggest users in countries such as Japan, Mexico, and the Philippines have seen access to the subscription during testing phases. Meta has not announced a complete list of supported regions.

That’s important because many users searching for Instagram Plus won’t find the option in their app yet. And at the moment, Meta has not confirmed a global launch date.

How to subscribe to Instagram Plus

If Instagram Plus becomes available for your account, subscribing should be straightforward.

Steps to buy Instagram Plus:

  1. Open the Instagram app on your mobile.
  2. Tap your profile picture to go to your profile.
  3. Select the menu icon and go to Accounts Center.
  4. Tap Subscriptions and select Instagram Plus.
  5. Hit Continue. Review the payment options and confirm your purchase.
  6. Complete payment through the App Store or Google Play Store.

Manage your subscription

After subscribing, you can manage your plan through Instagram Settings and Apple App Store or Google Play subscriptions.

Users will be able to:

  • view their subscription details,
  • check renewal date,
  • update payment method,
  • And cancel the subscription at any time.

What happens if you cancel Instagram Plus?

If you cancel Instagram Plus, your premium benefits will remain active until the current billing cycle ends.

After that:

  • Story previewing will be removed.
  • Extended Story duration features may disappear.
  • Premium audience tools will no longer be available.
  • Exclusive reactions and enhancements may be disabled.

Your account itself will remain unchanged. You won’t lose followers, posts, messages, or existing content.

Who should consider Instagram Plus?

Instagram Plus might not be for everyone, but some users might find it very helpful.

Get Instagram Plus if you:

  • Post Stories regularly
  • Manage a creator account
  • Run a business on Instagram
  • Need advanced audience controls
  • Want deeper Story analytics
  • Care about privacy features

Skip it if you:

  • Rarely post Stories
  • Use Instagram casually
  • Primarily watch Reels
  • Don’t care about engagement metrics

For many users, the free version will remain more than enough.

Final verdict: Is Instagram Plus worth it?

Instagram Plus may look like a collection of small features, but it represents a much bigger shift inside Meta. The company isn’t simply adding premium Story tools. It’s testing whether users are willing to pay for a better Instagram experience.

Some features feel genuinely useful. I really liked the idea of anonymous Story previewing, advanced audience controls, and deeper Story insights. Other features make the subscription feel complete.

What do you think about Instagram’s new paid subscription? Share your opinion in the comments below!

  • Instagram’s new AI voice effects

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. Codes usually appear during updates, events, milestones, or after bug fixes.

mainEntity.name: Can Ghoul Re Codes expire?

Update: Verified the latest Playground Basketball Codes on June 01, 2026

If you’ve been grinding Playground Basketball and watching your coin balance go nowhere, you’re not alone. The good news? There are active codes right now that hand you free coins, and using them takes less than a minute. Here’s everything you need: working codes, how to redeem them, and where to find more when these expire.

All Working Playground Basketball Codes

  • UPDATE8: 4.5k coins (NEW)
  • UPDATE7: 4.5k coins (NEW)
  • UPDATE5: 4.5k coins
  • STAGE: 4.5k coins
  • 25MVISITS: 7.5k coins

That’s up to 16,500 free coins if you redeem all three right now. That’s real progress toward move animations, stat upgrades, and cosmetics you’d otherwise grind hours for.

You can also grab rewards with Anime Last Stand codes, Anime Defenders codes, or explore all Roblox game codes for more freebies.

Expired Playground Basketball Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Playground Basketball Codes

Before anything else, there’s one thing most people miss that makes codes fail entirely. You must join the “Playground Basketball | Community” group on Roblox before codes will work. It’s a free group, just search it up on Roblox and hit Join. Skip this step and no code in the world will go through.

Once you’re in the group, here’s how to redeem:

  1. Launch Playground Basketball on Roblox and stay on the main menu.
  2. Look for the blue gift box icon in the top right corner and click it.

If you’re new to it, Playground Basketball is a Roblox sports game that’s more grounded than most. Forget the aura-farming and over-the-top dunks of other Roblox sports games. You build a customized player, train to improve your stats and traits, and take on real players in 1v1 or 2v2 matches across different courts, including city courts, park courts, and your own private practice area.

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

How to Redeem Evil Plate Game Codes

Redeeming codes in Evil Plate Game is slightly different from many other Roblox games because the code menu is accessed through an NPC in the lobby.

  2. Spawn into the lobby area.

  7. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.

If the code is valid, the shards will be instantly added to your account.

What Are Shards Used For in Evil Plate Game

Shards are the main currency in Evil Plate Game. Players earn them by surviving rounds, completing quests, logging in regularly, or redeeming codes.

You can spend shards on:

  • Cosmetic items such as horns, halos, and visual accessories
  • Emotes that allow you to interact with other players
  • Crates that unlock additional cosmetic rewards

These items do not affect gameplay strength. They simply add personality and fun to your character while you try to survive the chaos.

Another interesting mechanic in the game is the karma system. Players can use shards to bless or curse other players during a match. Depending on your choices, your karma meter will shift toward positive or negative values.

Sometimes a code might fail to redeem even if it looks correct. This usually happens for a few common reasons.

What is Evil Plate Game?

Evil Plate Game is a chaotic Roblox survival experience where each player stands on their own floating plate while random disasters constantly try to eliminate them. Lightning strikes, lasers fire across the arena, gravity may change suddenly, and platforms can shrink or sink without warning.

The goal is simple: survive longer than everyone else. As players are eliminated, the tension rises until only one person remains standing. That final survivor wins the round and earns the glory.

Because every round is unpredictable, quick reactions and good movement matter a lot. But with the help of free shards from codes, you can unlock fun cosmetics and enjoy the chaos in style.

Update: Verified the latest Diesel n Steel Codes on June 06, 2026

Running a Jeepney business in Diesel n’ Steel can be surprisingly demanding. Between buying new vehicles, repairing damage, paying for fuel, and upgrading your ride, you will constantly need more cash to keep things moving. The good news is that the developers occasionally release Diesel n Steel codes that reward players with free in‑game cash and other bonuses.

These rewards can give you a useful head start, especially when you are still building your first Jeepney route and learning how the game works. Below you will find the latest working Diesel n Steel codes along with instructions on how to redeem them.

All Working Diesel n Steel Codes

  • catcatcatcatcat: Free Cash (NEW)
  • kmjsdns: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • xltrelease: 6767 Cash and 670 EXP (NEW)
  • 3.8k: 5000 Cash and 167 EXP (NEW)
  • cadez_is_best: 4200 Cash and 69 EXP
  • DelayUpdate: Free cash
  • 60K: Free cash
  • <3: Free cash
  • Spawn Bug: Free cash
  • Milwaukee: Free cash

Keep in mind that Roblox codes can expire without warning, so it is always a good idea to redeem them as soon as possible.

Expired Diesel n Steel Codes

2026, AOITHEINVESTOR, BERMONTHS2025, BIGUPDATE!, BOSSREI, BUGCOMPENSATION, BUGFIX, CADEZ, COMPENSATION, DNSNUMBAWAN, DNSXMNLR21, FK, GIFTING, HAPPY10MVISITS, HAPPY20MVISITS, HAPPY25MVISITS, HAPPYXMAS2025, HIROMI, JAMBOHATDOGKAYAMOBATO, JAMDELABUSE, KAMOTE, MERVIN#1, PARZIGAMING, PATIENCE, PHASE2, PISO, PLSMONEY, SIOPASH, SUB2BOYIMBO, SUB2DAVEFROMPH, SWEETPOTATOLOVER, TEX, TRES, TY, WHOSEVIL?

How to Redeem Diesel n Steel Codes

Before you can redeem codes in Diesel n Steel, you need to reach a small milestone in the game. Once that requirement is complete, claiming rewards only takes a few seconds.

  1. Launch Diesel n Steel on Roblox.
  2. Play the game until you reach 500 EXP.
  3. Click the gift box icon or open the menu in the game interface.
  4. Select the Codes option.
  5. Enter a working code into the text field.
  6. Click Redeem to receive your reward.

If the code is valid, the rewards will be added to your account immediately.

Why Diesel n Steel Codes Are Useful

Diesel n Steel is a Roblox driving simulator set in Bulacan, Philippines, where players run a Jeepney transport business. Your goal is simple: buy a Jeepney, drive passengers along routes, and earn money while navigating busy roads.

However, running the business is not as easy as it sounds. You will need money for fuel, repairs, upgrades, and sometimes entirely new Jeepneys. Since earning cash through gameplay can take time, codes offer a quick way to get extra funds without grinding for hours.

With enough cash, you can upgrade your Jeepney faster and improve your overall driving experience in the game.

Why Diesel n Steel Codes Might Not Work

Sometimes a code may fail to redeem even if it appears correct. This usually happens for a few common reasons.

  1. You have not reached 500 EXP, which is required before codes can be redeemed.
  2. The code may have expired after a game update.
  3. The code may have been typed incorrectly, since Roblox codes are case‑sensitive.

To avoid errors, it is usually best to copy and paste the codes directly into the game.

How to Find More Diesel n Steel Codes

New Diesel n Steel codes are typically released when the game receives updates or reaches community milestones. Developers often share them through the official Diesel n Steel Discord server or Roblox community posts.

You can bookmark this page as well, and we will update the list whenever new Diesel n Steel codes are released. Check the All Roblox Game Codes Master List to find working codes for every game.

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

Update: Verified the latest Titan Fishing Codes on June 01, 2026

Titan Fishing is one of those Roblox games where patience, timing, and persistence matter just as much as luck. Instead of catching small fish, players face enormous sea creatures that can weigh thousands of kilograms. Each battle becomes a test of speed and endurance as you tap continuously to weaken the fish before the time runs out.

To progress faster, Titan Fishing codes can give you useful rewards like free money, exclusive rod skins, and powerful skill books. These rewards help you roll for stronger abilities and improve your chances of landing massive catches.

All Working Titan Fishing Codes

  • TAIJIEVENT: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • TITANFISHING NEW: Godzilla Blade Skin
  • 1MVISITS NEW: 50K Money

These rewards are particularly useful early on. Money allows you to roll for skill books, while items like Mythical Books can unlock powerful abilities that make catching giant fish significantly easier.

Expired Titan Fishing Codes

LOVES2026, SORRY2026

How to Redeem Titan Fishing Codes

Redeeming codes in Titan Fishing only takes a few seconds once you know where to look. Follow these steps:

  1. Launch Titan Fishing in Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings icon on the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll down to the code redemption box.
  4. Enter a working code exactly as shown.
  5. Click Claim to receive your rewards.

If the code is valid, the rewards will instantly appear in your account.

Check the All Roblox Game Codes Master List to find working codes for every game.

What Rewards Do Titan Fishing Codes Give?

Titan Fishing codes usually reward players with items that help progress faster in the game. These rewards may include:

  • Money used for rolling skill books
  • Rod skins for customizing your fishing rod
  • Skill books that grant powerful fishing abilities

Skill books are especially important because they directly affect your fishing power and strategy.

What Are Skill Books in Titan Fishing?

Skill Books are special items obtained by rolling at an NPC in the game. Each roll grants one random book, with rarities ranging from common books to extremely rare Mythical books.

Without skill books, fishing becomes far more difficult. These abilities improve your effectiveness when battling giant fish, which is why players often spend large amounts of money rolling for better books.

The price of each roll increases over time. For example:

  • First roll: 20,000 money
  • Second roll: 21,000 money
  • Third roll: 22,000 money

Because the price increases with every roll, free money from codes can be extremely valuable.

Why Titan Fishing Codes Might Not Work

Sometimes a code may fail to redeem even if it appears correct. This usually happens for a few common reasons:

  1. The code has expired. Codes often stop working after updates or milestone events. If a code is expired, the game will reject it.
  2. Typing mistakes. Titan Fishing codes are case‑sensitive, so even a small typo or missing character can prevent redemption. Copying and pasting the code usually avoids this problem.
  3. Server issues. Occasionally, the server may not process the code correctly. Leaving the game and joining a new server often fixes the issue.

How to Get More Titan Fishing Codes

New Titan Fishing codes are usually released when the game reaches major milestones or receives updates.

The best way to find new codes quickly is by checking the official Titan Fishing Discord server, where developers often post announcements and update notes. You can also follow community pages and developer social media accounts where new codes are occasionally shared.

Bookmark this page and check back regularly. We update this guide whenever new Titan Fishing codes are released, so you never miss free rewards.

What Is Titan Fishing?

Titan Fishing is a Roblox fishing game where players hunt for massive fish that can weigh thousands of kilograms. Instead of passive fishing, every catch turns into an active battle where you must tap rapidly to damage the fish before the timer expires.

Players earn money from successful catches, which can then be used to roll for powerful skill books, upgrade abilities, and customize their rods with skins.

Over time, you build a stronger fishing setup and take on even larger sea creatures. The mix of progression, skill upgrades, and intense fishing battles is what makes Titan Fishing stand out from typical Roblox fishing games.

With new updates and milestone rewards appearing regularly, redeeming the latest Titan Fishing codes is one of the easiest ways to stay ahead and strengthen your fishing build.

  • Jujutsu Kaisen Incremental Codes
  • Garden Horizons Codes
  • Evil Plate Game Codes
  • Diesel n Steel Codes

Update: Verified the latest Jujutsu Legacy Codes on June 01, 2026

If you are grinding your way through Jujutsu Legacy and trying to build the perfect character, spins are everything. Your race, clan, and technique define how strong you become, and early on, getting enough spins can feel slow and frustrating. That is where these Jujutsu Legacy codes help. They give you free technique, clan, and race spins so you can reroll until you land the build you actually want.

Below you will find all working codes, expired codes, and clear steps to redeem them.

All Working Jujutsu Legacy Codes

  • MutualLove: 40 Technique spins
  • Dessert: Free Technique spins
  • Mahoraga: 30 Technique spins
  • WUpd: 30 Technique spins
  • Just This Once: 10 Technique spins
  • Takaba: 20 Technique spins
  • AlwaysBetOnHakari: 20 Clan Spin
  • Sorry: 20 Technique Spins
  • SkyManipulation: 20 Technique Spins
  • Cursed: 10 Technique Spins
  • SkillIssue: 3 Technique Spins

These spins let you reroll your current setup. Keep in mind that when you spin, it replaces your currently equipped race, clan, or technique. If you get something rare and do not want to lose it later, store it in your technique storage before spinning again.

Expired Jujutsu Legacy Codes

1.5KLIKES, 10KLIKES, 11KLIKES, 12KLIKES, 2.5KLIKES, 2KLIKES, 3.5KLIKES, 3KLIKES, 4.5KLIKES, 4KLIKES, 5.5KLIKES, 5KLIKES, 6.5KLIKES, 6KLIKES, 7.5KLIKES, 7KLIKES, 8.5KLIKES, 8KLIKES, 9.5KLIKES, 9KLIKES, BLOODMANIPULATION, CAT GOJO, CHRISTMAS1, COMEDIAN, DISASTERFLAMES, GIFTS, HANAMI, HIGURUMA, INFINITY, ISHIGORI, JACKPOT, KRAMPUS SUKUNA, RACESPIN2, SORRYFORGIVESPECIALCLAN, SORRYFORINFBUGS, SORRYSHUTDOWN, WCHRISTMAS

How To Redeem Jujutsu Legacy Codes

Before you redeem any code, you must reach level 5. You can do this quickly by defeating Jujutsu students near the spawn area.

Once you are level 5, follow these steps:

  1. Launch Jujutsu Legacy in Roblox.
  2. Press M or tap the menu button on the left side of your screen.
  3. Enter a working code in the redeem box.
  4. Press OK or hit Enter on your keyboard.

Your free spins will be added instantly.

To use your spins, head to the building near the spawn point and talk to the relevant NPC. Choose whether you want to spin for technique, clan, or race.

What Are Jujutsu Legacy Codes?

Jujutsu Legacy codes are free rewards released by the developer, kauan123ro. Most new codes appear when the game hits milestones, such as 5KLIKES or 10KLIKES. Sometimes they also drop during updates or as compensation for bugs and shutdowns.

That is why you see codes like SorryShutdown or SorryForInfBugs. They are usually apology rewards and often give large amounts of spins.

Why Your Codes Might Not Work

If a code does not redeem, check the following:

  • Make sure you are level 5.
  • Double-check spelling. Codes are case sensitive.
  • Copy and paste directly to avoid typing mistakes.
  • The code may have expired.
  • The game may have just updated. Wait a few minutes and try again.

How to Get More Jujutsu Legacy Codes

The easiest way to stay updated is to check this page regularly. We update the list as soon as new codes are released.

You can also join the official Jujutsu Legacy Discord server and check the codes channel for announcements from the developer.

If you are serious about building the perfect character, these free spins make a huge difference. Instead of settling for average stats, you can keep rolling until you land the combo that actually feels powerful.

Use the codes, store your rare rolls wisely, and keep leveling. The right build can completely change how Jujutsu Legacy feels to play.

Related articles worth reading

  • Garden Horizons Codes
  • Evil Plate Game Codes
