  • NN8C432Z26W: Redeem for 1 Lucky Spin
  • Y8YRH79G4NX: Redeem for 2 Spins
  • Z2KZQQB5772: Redeem for 5 Spins
  • 5SKDPJF2B42: Redeem for 3 Lucky Spins
  • Y7Q667XRSJK: Mythic Frozen Racket
  • GHZT2Q8MGDH: Redeem for 2 Spins
  • MCZW25EASR7: Rare Ice Racket

Roblox codes can expire without warning, so redeem them as soon as possible. If a code does not work, check the spelling first, then try copying it directly from the list.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Brainrot Evolution codes, Clover Origins codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Neo Tennis codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Neo Tennis codes

Redeeming codes in Neo Tennis is simple once you know where to go. The game does not hide the menu deep inside settings. You need to find the in-game code area and enter your reward there.

  1. Launch Neo Tennis on Roblox.
  2. Look for the hologram or area with CODE above it.
  3. Walk up to it and hold or press the prompted button, usually E.
  4. Enter a working code in the text box.
  5. Click the Check button to claim your reward.

If the code is valid, the reward should be added to your account right away. If it fails, the code may be expired, already redeemed, or typed incorrectly.

What are Neo Tennis codes used for?

Neo Tennis codes are useful because they give you free rewards that help with progression and customization. Most current codes give Lucky Spins or Spins, which can help you roll for better items. Some codes can also unlock special rackets, like the Ice Racket.

That matters because Neo Tennis is built around fast, stylish matches. The game was previously known as Tennis! and before that Tennis Clash, and it follows the same idea of turning regular tennis into a more energetic Roblox sports experience. Instead of plain rallies, you get powerful shots, flashy abilities, and matches that feel closer to an anime sports duel than a normal tennis game.

How to get more Neo Tennis codes

The easiest option is to bookmark this page, because we will update it when new codes are released or old ones stop working.

You can also check the official Neo Tennis Discord server. Codes are usually shared in the codes channel, but they may also appear in announcements or update logs when the developers push new content.

Why are my Neo Tennis codes not working?

A code can fail for a few simple reasons. Before assuming it is expired, check these common issues first.

  • The code was typed with a mistake.
  • The code has already been redeemed on your account.
  • The code has expired.
  • The game server has not refreshed yet.
  • The reward name changed after a newer update.

The safest method is to copy and paste the code exactly as shown. If it still does not work, restart Roblox and try again in a new server.

Final words

Neo Tennis is more fun when you are not stuck grinding for every small upgrade. These codes give you a quick boost with Lucky Spins, Spins, and a free racket, so you can spend more time playing matches and less time waiting for rewards.

Bookmark this page and check back often. New Neo Tennis codes can drop with updates, milestones, or Discord announcements, and we will keep the list fresh whenever more rewards arrive.

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

Before redeeming codes, you need to join the Funzy Labs Roblox group. If you skip that step, the code system may not work for you even if the code itself is active.

  2. Click the Menu button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Select Info from the menu.
  4. Enter a working code in the Code here box.
  5. Press Enter to claim your rewards.

Once the code works, the rewards should be added to your account. If you are using a boost code like SORRYSHUTDOWN!, redeem it only when you are ready to play, because timed boosts are more valuable when you can actually use the full duration.

Why your Clover Origins codes may not work

Clover Origins codes can fail for a few simple reasons, and the error message usually tells you what happened.

If the game says Invalid, check the spelling first. Codes are case-sensitive, and many of them end with an exclamation mark. A missing symbol or extra space can stop the code from working. If the code is brand new, it may also take a little time to appear across every server.

If the game says Codes Used, you have already claimed that code on your account. Clover Origins codes can only be redeemed once per player.

If the game says Expired, the developer has removed the code. In that case, you will need to use one of the current working codes instead.

How to get more Clover Origins codes

New Clover Origins codes usually arrive when the game reaches new like milestones, gets updates, receives bug fixes, or has a server shutdown. The Funzy Labs Discord server is the best official place to watch for new code drops, especially around announcements.

Still, Discord codes can be easy to miss, and copying them with the right formatting can be annoying. Bookmark this page and check back often, because we will keep the working list updated and move dead codes into the expired section when they stop working.

What are Clover Origins codes used for?

Clover Origins is the kind of Roblox anime game where your build matters. You are not just collecting rewards for fun. You are using spins and resets to shape the character you actually want to play.

Yen helps with progression, grimoire spins help you chase better magic, race spins let you reroll your race, broom spins help with broom options, trait spins help with character bonuses, and stat resets let you fix mistakes without starting over. That makes these codes useful for both new players and returning players who want to rebuild after an update.

Use the newest codes first, especially the shutdown and bug-fix codes, because those can disappear faster than regular milestone codes.

mainEntity.name: Where do I enter Jujutsu Infinite codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

acceptedAnswer.text: Occasionally during big events, it is more common for codes to grant spins, yen, or boosts that help you roll or progress toward rare techniques. Always check the code description for the exact reward and expiry.

How to redeem Brainrot Evolution codes

Redeeming codes in Brainrot Evolution is simple, but the codes menu is inside the shop, so it is easy to miss the first time.

  1. Open Brainrot Evolution in Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Click the Codes button, or scroll until you reach the codes section.
  4. Enter a working code in the text box.
  5. Click Verify to claim your free rewards.

Once the code works, the reward should be added to your account. If you are using EXP Potions or Mega EXP Potions, save them for a proper grinding session so you get the most value from the boost.

Why is my Brainrot Evolution code not working?

Most code issues come down to typos. Brainrot Evolution codes can include capital letters, numbers, and spaces, so even a small mistake can stop the code from working.

What is Brainrot Evolution?

Brainrot Evolution is a Roblox clicker and evolution game built around chaotic internet humor. You start small, eat or destroy objects, grow stronger, collect wins, hatch pets, and unlock more Brainrot evolutions as you keep playing.

The appeal is simple: it is weird, fast, and built for players who enjoy watching numbers go up while their character turns into something more ridiculous. Codes make that loop smoother by giving you boosts and crates without forcing you to grind from scratch.

How to get more Brainrot Evolution codes

New Brainrot Evolution codes usually arrive through the game’s official community pages. You can check the Brainrot Evolution Discord server, the developer’s X account at @xFrozenStudios, and the official i2Perfect YouTube channel for updates.

acceptedAnswer.text: Open Jujutsu Infinite, tap Menu, then go to Customize or open the in-game Shop. Look for the code field, paste your code, and tap Redeem. On iPhone or iPad, tap and hold a code to Copy, then paste it in the box.

mainEntity.name: Why won't my code work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons include typos, case sensitivity, expired codes, or a code already used on your account. Make sure you are on a fresh server version by leaving and rejoining the game and try again after a minute in case of server delay.

mainEntity.name: Are Jujutsu Infinite codes safe to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you redeem them in game and only use codes shared by the developers on official channels like the Roblox game page or the official Discord. Avoid third-party sites and never share your Roblox login or 2FA codes.

mainEntity.name: How often are new Jujutsu Infinite codes released?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no fixed schedule. New codes usually arrive around major updates, milestone celebrations, or special events. Following the official channels is the best way to catch them quickly.

mainEntity.name: Can I use the same Jujutsu Infinite code twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, each code is single-use per account.

mainEntity.name: Do codes ever give rare characters or techniques?

Update: Verified the latest World Fighters Codes on June 03, 2026

World Fighters is the kind of Roblox anime game where the fun starts fast, but the grind catches up even faster. You build a team with familiar anime-style heroes, collect stronger fighters, upgrade your setup, and keep pushing for better rewards.

That is exactly where World Fighters’ codes help. These codes give you free gems, potions, keys, and other rewards, so you can boost your progress without spending as much time grinding.

Most World Fighters codes give you potions, gems, and keys. Potions are useful when you want stronger boosts, gems help with progression, and keys can unlock important game rewards. The exact reward can vary by code, but all of them are worth claiming if you are actively playing.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest King Legacy codes, Unbox a Factory codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

How to redeem World Fighters codes

Redeeming codes in World Fighters is simple, but the code box is not on the main screen. You need to open the shop menu first and scroll to the code section.

  1. Open World Fighters on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll to the bottom of the shop menu.
  4. Find the Codes section.
  5. Paste a working code into the Code Here… box.
  6. Press Redeem to claim your rewards.

You should redeem the codes one at a time. Copying and pasting is the safest method because many codes use punctuation, capital letters, and special characters.

What are World Fighters codes?

World Fighters codes are free reward codes released by the game’s developer. They usually arrive when the game reaches a milestone, gets an update, hits a player count goal, or receives a certain number of likes, visits, or favorites.

The rewards are built to make the grind easier. Instead of slowly farming everything from scratch, you can use codes to grab gems, potions, Dragon Balls Keys, Saiyan Keys, and special items like the Gadi Jetpack.

That matters because World Fighters is all about building a better anime team. The more resources you have, the easier it becomes to unlock fighters, strengthen your setup, and keep up with harder content.

How to get more World Fighters codes

New World Fighters codes usually appear around updates and community milestones. If the game reaches a new visits goal, likes goal, concurrent player count, or favorites milestone, there is a good chance another code may follow.

The best places to check are the official World Fighters Discord server and the StarX Inc YouTube channel, where the developer shares game-related updates. You can also bookmark this page, because we will keep the list updated when new codes arrive.

Why are my World Fighters codes not Working?

If a World Fighters code is not working, the most common reason is a typing mistake. These codes often include symbols like exclamation marks and question marks, so even one missing character can break the code.

Here are the main things to check:

  • Make sure there are no extra spaces before or after the code.
  • Copy and paste the code instead of typing it manually.
  • Check that every symbol, number, and capital letter matches.
  • Try again after a server reset if the code is brand new.
  • If the code still fails, it may have expired.

Roblox codes can stop working suddenly, even if they were active earlier. When that happens, the only fix is to wait for the developer to release a new one.

World Fighters codes make the early grind easier

World Fighters is more fun when you are building your dream anime team, not when you are stuck farming the same rewards for hours. These codes give you a strong head start with free potions, gems, keys, and special items.

Redeem every active code while it still works, then check back whenever the game gets a new update or hits another milestone. In a game built around collecting and upgrading, free rewards can save a lot of time.

Update: Verified the latest Be a Brainrot Codes on June 01, 2026

Be a Brainrot takes the familiar Roblox brainrot formula and flips it. Instead of chasing brainrots, you are the brainrot. You sneak into enemy bases, grab one of theirs, and rush back before getting caught. The faster you move, the more you steal, and the quicker your base scales.

That is where codes come in. They give you instant cash, which directly translates into speed upgrades and stronger brainrots. If you use them early, progression feels much smoother.

All Working Be a Brainrot codes

  • BRAINROT: 5000 Cash (NEW)
  • RELEASE: 10000 Cash (NEW)

These codes are currently active and verified. Use them as soon as possible since they can expire without warning.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Black Grimoire Code, Hunt Giant Fish Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Be a Brainrot codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Be a Brainrot codes

Redeeming codes only takes a few seconds, and you should do it as soon as you load into the game.

  1. Open Be a Brainrot on Roblox.
  2. Click the Settings icon in the top right corner.
  3. Find the “Enter code” box.
  4. Paste a working code exactly as shown.
  5. Press Enter to claim your reward.

Make sure there are no extra spaces before or after the code. Even a small mistake will cause it to fail.

Why codes matter in Be a Brainrot

Cash is the core resource in the game. Everything you care about depends on it.

  • Faster speed lets you steal and escape more efficiently
  • Stronger brainrots improve your overall runs
  • Base upgrades increase long-term earnings
  • Offline brainrots generate more cash with upgrades

Using codes early gives you a noticeable advantage. You move faster, scale quicker, and spend less time grinding basic upgrades.

How to get more Be a Brainrot codes

New codes do not follow a fixed schedule, so finding them manually can be frustrating.

The best approach is to bookmark this page and check back regularly. New codes are added as soon as they drop, so you do not miss free rewards.

If you prefer checking yourself, keep an eye on:

  • The official Discord server
  • The Roblox group “Steal a garden or something”

Developers usually release codes during updates, events, or milestones.

Why are your Be a Brainrot codes not working

If a code does not work, there are only a few possible reasons:

  • You typed it incorrectly
  • You added extra spaces
  • The code has expired

The easiest fix is to copy and paste the code directly. If it still fails, it is likely no longer active.

Keep this page bookmarked

Codes in Be a Brainrot do not last forever, and missing even one can slow down your progress. Bookmark this page and check back often. New codes are added as soon as they are released, so you always stay ahead.

In case you missed

  • Clover Origins codes
  • Brainrot Evolution codes
  • King Legacy codes

Update: Verified the latest Summon Heroes Codes on June 04, 2026

Starting out in Summon Heroes feels slow at first. You do not have enough heroes, your team is weak, and progress depends on what you can summon. That is where codes make a real difference. They give you free resources early on, so you can build a stronger squad without waiting.

Summon Heroes is a strategy-based auto battler on Roblox where you summon heroes, build a team, and let them fight enemies across different stages. Each hero has its own abilities and stats, so the game is not just about collecting units, but also about how you use them.

All Working Summon Heroes Codes

  • RUNEHYPE: 10x Trait Rerolls
  • HURRYUP: 15x Trait Rerolls
  • DIVINE: 5x Trait Rerolls
  • ULTIMATE: 5x Trait Rerolls
  • SUNSET NEW: x5 Legendary Crystals
  • MOARSHARD: 3x Mythic Shards
  • OOF: 250x Gems
  • DUNGEONZ: 3x Mythic Shards
  • DELAYHEROES: 5x Summon Tickets
  • 500GEMS: 500x Gems

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Anime Vanguards Codes, Arise Ragnarok Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Summon Heroes Codes

DIVINEORSERAPH, LEGEND

Why These Codes Matter

If you are just starting, these rewards are not small. Gems let you summon new heroes, which directly improves your team. Summon Tickets speed up that process even more. Mythic Shards and Fusion Crystals help you push toward stronger units faster.

Without codes, you rely on grinding stages, completing quests, and opening chests. Codes simply skip part of that grind and give you a head start.

How to Redeem Codes in Summon Heroes

Redeeming codes is simple once you know where to look, but it is not placed directly in front of you.

  1. Open Summon Heroes on Roblox
  2. Complete the tutorial if you are new
  3. In the main lobby, turn left and cross a small bridge
  4. Look for the Item Codes circle
  5. Step inside it to open the code menu
  6. Enter your code and claim rewards

If a code does not work, check the spelling. Codes are case sensitive, so even a small mistake can fail it.

How to Get More Codes

New codes usually show up when the game gets updates, events, or hits milestones. Developers also share them through official channels like Discord, X, and YouTube.

If you do not want to keep checking everywhere, bookmark this page and come back when updates happen. We keep this list updated with the latest working codes.

What Is Summon Heroes

Summon Heroes is built around a simple loop. You summon heroes using gems, build a team, and let them automatically fight enemies. As you progress, you unlock stronger units and tougher stages.

The game also includes PvP, where you can test your team against other players. This is where strategy matters more, because simply having strong units is not enough if your team setup is weak.

Over time, you earn rewards like gems, currency, and XP items through stages, quests, and achievements. You can also sell unused heroes to get extra resources.

  • Survive the Apocalypse codes
  • My Dragon Island Codes
  • Waste Time Codes

Update: Verified the latest Hunt Giant Fish Codes on June 01, 2026

If you expected a calm fishing game, Hunt Giant Fish flips that idea completely. Instead of sitting with a rod, you are out in the water, shooting massive fish with powerful weapons. It feels fast, chaotic, and surprisingly rewarding. The loop is simple but addictive. You hunt fish, display them in your aquarium, and they slowly generate coins while you keep upgrading your gear.

This is where codes come in. Progress can feel slow early on, especially when better weapons and upgrades cost a lot. Codes give you a boost right when you need it, helping you deal more damage, land critical hits, and earn more coins without grinding for hours.

All working Hunt Giant Fish codes

  • CTHULHUMADNESS: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • FISHCOLLECTIONREACH: Free Rewards (NEW)
  • 10KCCUAGAIN: Free Rewards
  • CTHULHURISE: Free Rewards
  • 10KCCU: Free Potions
  • DEEPSEA: Free Potions
  • 5KCCU: Free Potions
  • AATHANKYOU: Free Potions
  • SEADRAGON: Free Potions
  • LUNARLUCK: 2 Pineapple King and 2 Plus 50% Earning Potion
  • SPRINGUPDATE: Free Potions
  • 10000LIKES: 10000000 Coins and 5 VIP Damage Potion
  • NEWYEAR2026: 1 70% Critical Potion, 1 30% Critical Potion, 1 Damage Potion, and 1 VIP Damage Potion
  • 5000LIKES: 2 VIP Damage Potion and 1000000 Coins
  • HAPPYXMAS: 2 70% Critical Potion and 2 Damage Potion
  • 1000LIKES: 1 Pineapple King and 2 70% Critical Potion
  • 500LIKES: 1 70% Critical Potion and 2 Dragon Fruit
  • 100LIKES: 1 Dragon Fruit and 1 VIP Damage Potion
  • HUNTER999: One 30% Critical Potion and 10000 Coins

These codes are currently active and verified. Use them as soon as possible since they can expire without warning.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Black Grimoire Code, Go Catch Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Hunt Giant Fish codes

Right now, there are no expired codes for Hunt Giant Fish. Every code listed above is still working. That said, this usually does not last long. Roblox games often remove codes quietly, so it is always better to redeem them early instead of saving them.

How to redeem Hunt Giant Fish codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

Why these codes actually matter

At the start, your damage is low and fish take time to defeat. This slows down everything, from earning coins to unlocking better weapons. That is where these rewards make a real difference.

  • Damage potions help you take down fish faster
  • Critical potions increase your chance of big hits
  • Earning boosts improve your coin generation
  • Coins let you skip early grinding completely

The faster you progress, the quicker your aquarium fills up with rare fish that keep earning for you in the background.

How to get more Hunt Giant Fish codes

New codes usually drop during important moments in the game’s lifecycle. Once you understand the pattern, it becomes easy to predict when to check.

  • Game updates and patches
  • Milestones like likes or concurrent players
  • Seasonal events and holidays
  • Bug fixes or server downtime compensation

You can find them on the game’s Roblox page or the GiantTank Roblox group. But tracking all of that manually gets messy fast.

The easier approach is simple. Bookmark this page and check back regularly. New codes will be added here as soon as they are released, so you do not miss limited-time rewards.

Why your code might not work

If a code fails, it usually comes down to two reasons.

  • Typing errors. Some characters look similar but are different
  • The code has expired silently

If you copy and paste and it still does not work, then it is most likely no longer active.

What makes Hunt Giant Fish different

Most Roblox fishing games focus on patience. This one is the opposite. You are actively chasing fish, shooting them, and optimizing your loadout. It feels closer to an action game than a traditional fishing sim.

The aquarium system adds another layer. Every fish you catch keeps working for you, generating coins over time. That passive income loop makes progression feel steady, even when you are not actively grinding.

That mix of action and idle progression is what keeps players coming back. And with the right codes, you can skip the slow start and jump straight into the fun part of the game.

In case you missed

  • Anime Apocalypse codes
  • King Legacy codes
  • Be a Brainrot Codes

Update: Verified the latest BLR Legacy Codes on June 01, 2026

BLR: Legacy feels like opening an old photo album. The game brings back the classic Blue Lock Rivals vibe that many Roblox players grew up loving. If you played the original, this version will hit you with pure nostalgia. And if you are new, you are stepping into one of the most exciting soccer experiences on the platform. The best part is that you do not have to start empty handed. BLR: Legacy codes give you free money, boosts, and spins to help you build your character faster and enjoy the game without endless grinding.

All Active BLR: Legacy Codes

  • CUSTOMSFIXED – spins
  • EASTER – five lucky style spins and five lucky flow spins
  • KURONA – ten lucky style spins and ten lucky flow spins
  • BACKUP – $50k cash, 25 spins, 25 flow spins, 50 lucky spins, and 15 lucky flow spins
  • BUG_FIXES! – ten lucky style spins and ten lucky flow spins
  • NEL_SKIN – ten lucky style spins and ten lucky flow spins
  • OG_OTOYA! – ten style spins
  • SORRY_FOR_SHUTDOWN – five lucky style spins and ten normal style spins

Expired BLR: Legacy Codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to Redeem Codes in BLR: Legacy

Redeeming codes in BLR: Legacy is not as simple as other Roblox games. The developers added a few requirements to stop bots and reward real players. You must first join the iluvlily Roblox group, like the BLR: Legacy game page, and reach at least level 5 inside the game before the system allows any code to work.

After completing those requirements, follow these steps to redeem your rewards.

  1. Open BLR: Legacy in Roblox.
  2. Press the Codes button at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Type the code exactly as shown without any extra spaces.
  4. Click Redeem and enjoy your rewards.

If you skip any of the requirements above, the game will not accept your codes.

How to Get More BLR: Legacy Codes

New codes usually appear when the game hits milestones like visits, group members, or big updates. The main place to find them is the BLR: Legacy Discord server, where developers post announcements and events. You can also check the Roblox group page and the game description for surprise drops.

If you do not want to hunt for codes yourself, keeping this page saved is the easiest way. We update the list whenever new rewards arrive.

Why Your BLR: Legacy Codes Might Not Work

Sometimes a code refuses to redeem, and it can be frustrating. The most common reasons are simple, and almost all issues fall into one of these points.

  • You typed the code wrong or changed a letter by mistake.
  • There is an extra space before or after the code.
  • You have not joined the iluvlily Roblox group yet.
  • Your account has not reached level 5 in the game.
  • The code has already expired after a new update.
  • The code was redeemed earlier on your account.
  • Roblox servers are temporarily slow and need a restart.

Always copy the code exactly as written and double-check the requirements before assuming it is broken.

What Is BLR: Legacy?

BLR: Legacy is a fan made tribute to the early days of Blue Lock Rivals. It recreates the original mechanics, movement, and feel that older players remember. The game focuses on pure soccer action instead of heavy modern systems. You can play as striker, midfielder, or defender and build your character through matches and training.

The experience is less about flashy menus and more about the thrill of scoring that perfect goal with your team.

Styles and Flows Rewards Explained

Spins from codes are valuable because they unlock Styles and Flows.

Styles are special playstyles inspired by Blue Lock characters. They change how your player moves, shoots, and controls the ball. Some styles are aggressive, others focus on speed or technique.

Flows are visual and ability effects that trigger during key moments. They make your moves look powerful and give you a unique identity on the field.

Getting lucky spins means a higher chance to roll rare and stronger abilities.

Final Note

BLR: Legacy is more than just another Roblox sports game. It is a throwback to a time when gameplay mattered more than anything else. With these codes you can skip some of the early grind and jump straight into the fun. Redeem them, experiment with styles, and find your own way to dominate the field. The legacy is waiting for you.

Missed This? Check It Out

  • Roblox Control Codes
  • Roblox Deep Codes
  • Anime Spike Codes
  • Survive the Apocalypse codes

Update: Verified the latest Catch And Tame Codes on June 01, 2026

Catch and Tame make food matter early because fed pets can help your luck and keep the ranch grind moving. Codes are the quickest way to grab extra items without waiting on shops or event drops, but this game burns through older codes fast.

Below are the working Catch and Tame codes, the expired ones, and the quick steps to redeem them from the Backpack menu.

All working Catch and Tame codes

  • 1MLikes: 25 Crystals, 25 Peppers, and 25 Cosmic Fruits (NEW)
  • Abyssarea: x10 crystals 1MLikes – 25 crystals 25 peppers 25 cosmic fruits
  • MAGMA: x10 peppers

Use this code exactly as shown. Catch and Tame codes are case-sensitive, and older food/event codes have been expiring quickly after recent updates.

Expired Catch and Tame codes

ABDUCTED, BEEISLAND, CANDYBLOSSOM, CATTEAM, CAVEUPDATE, DOGTEAM, EASTERUPDATE, FORGOTTENDEPTHS, FREEBONES, FREESTEAK, MOONRISES, SAFARIUPDATE, SECRETYETI, SKYISLAND, SPACEEVENT, STEAMPUNK, UPDATE11, UPDATE12, UPDATE13, UPDATE14, UPDATE15, UPDATE16, VALENTINES

How to redeem Catch and Tame codes

The code button is inside your Backpack, so it is easy to miss if you are looking only at the main screen.

  1. Open Catch And Tame on Roblox.
  2. Click the Backpack icon at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Select the Codes button.
  4. Enter a working code into the text box.
  5. Press Redeem to claim your reward.

You can also press the tilde/backtick key to open the Backpack faster on the keyboard.

Why is your Catch and Tame code not working

Most failed codes come down to one of these issues:

  • The code has expired.
  • There is a typo, a wrong capital letter, or extra space.
  • You already redeemed the code on your account.
  • You are on an older server that has not refreshed yet.
  • Roblox or the game server is having a temporary issue.

Copy and paste the code if possible. If a new code still fails, close the game, join a fresh server, and try again before assuming it is dead.

Where to find more Catch and Tame codes

New Catch and Tame codes usually drop around updates, events, bug fixes, or player milestones. The best places to watch are the Catch And Tame Roblox page, the Manta Games Roblox group, and the Catch & Tame Discord.

You can also bookmark this page if you want the active list without testing every old food code yourself. If you want more free rewards, check out the Immortality Incremental codes, Arcade Basketball codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

What is Catch and Tame?

Catch and Tame is a Roblox animal-collecting game by Manta Games. You equip a lasso, catch roaming animals, bring them back to your pen, feed them, and combine pets to discover rarer animals.

Codes will not replace the main grind, but free food is always useful when you are trying to grow earnings and build a better collection faster.

Update: Verified the latest Immortality Incremental Codes on June 04, 2026

Immortality Incremental can make early breakthroughs feel slow once your Qi gains flatten out. Codes help because Potions speed up your grind, Tickets push you toward better rewards, and Jade is worth grabbing before milestone codes disappear.

Below are the working Immortality Incremental codes you should redeem first, plus the steps to claim them from the in-game Shop.

All working Immortality Incremental codes

  • 5MVISITS: 10 tickets and 20 of each potion (NEW)
  • MINI2: 10 jade, 5 of each potion (NEW)
  • COOLBEANS: 5 of each potion (NEW)
  • 10KSERVER: 10 of each potion and 5 tickets
  • YAAY: 10 jade
  • LAWS: 5 of each potion
  • 100KFAV: 10 of each potion and 5 tickets
  • MINI: 3 of each potion and 5 Jade
  • 100KGROUP: 10 of each potion
  • NERF: 5 Jade
  • 1MVISITS: 10 each potion and 5 jade
  • 5KCCU: 5 each potion and 10 tickets
  • ASH: 3 each potion
  • HYPE: 5 tickets
  • PART1: 5 Tickets and 5 of each potion
  • 50KGROUP: 10 of each potion
  • EXTRACODE: 10 Jade, 5 of each potion
  • 1KGOATS: 10 of each potion
  • PART2: 10 Tickets and 2 of each potion
  • DELAY: 10 Tickets and 7 Jade
  • UPDATE2: 2 of each potion
  • MEMBERS: 10 tickets
  • DurpJade: 5 Jade
  • HOTFIX: 1 of each potion
  • RELEASE: 1 of each potion

Redeem the newest milestone codes first, then work down the list. Copy each code exactly as shown, especially mixed-case codes like DurpJade.

Some older public lists disagree on a few reward amounts, so do not wait too long on the Jade and milestone codes. If a code works but gives a slightly different potion count, treat the reward in-game as the final word.

Expired Immortality Incremental codes

SORRYFORMISTAKE

How to redeem Immortality Incremental codes

The code box is inside the Shop, so you may need to scroll a little after opening the menu.

  1. Open Immortality Incremental on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll down to the Codes section.
  4. Paste or type a working code into the code box.
  5. Click Use to claim your reward.

Rewards should land instantly if the code is valid. If nothing happens, leave the game, join a fresh server, and try the code again before assuming it is dead.

Why your Immortality Incremental code is not working?

Start with the simple checks first. Most Roblox code errors come from typing, expired codes, or old servers rather than a broken account.

  • The code has expired or was removed after a new update.
  • You typed the code with the wrong capitalization, an extra space, or a missing character.
  • You already redeemed that code on your Roblox account.
  • You are on an older server that has not synced the latest code list.
  • The game is temporarily bugged after an update or shutdown.
  • A reward is tied to the official group, game like, favorite, or community server requirement.

For mixed-case codes, copy and paste instead of retyping. If a newly released code fails, server-hop once; fresh update codes can take a little time to work everywhere.

Where to find more Immortality Incremental codes

New Immortality Incremental codes usually appear around updates, visit milestones, concurrent-player milestones, hotfixes, and apology drops. These are the best places to watch:

  • Immortality Incremental Roblox page
  • Immortality Incremental Roblox community
  • Immortality Incremental Discord

Discord is useful if you want codes the moment they drop, but it can also be messy when you only want the working list. Bookmark this page if you prefer a cleaner set of codes to test first.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Jujutsu Randomizer codes, Arcade Basketball codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

What is Immortality Incremental?

Immortality Incremental is a Roblox cultivation clicker where you build Qi, push through breakthroughs, reset for stronger layers, open Marks, and climb toward higher realms. It has a built-in autoclicker, but the grind still stretches out once upgrades and breakthroughs get expensive.

Codes matter because they feed the parts of the loop that slow you down early: Potions for faster progress, Tickets for extra reward paths, and Jade for rarer boosts. They will not skip the whole cultivation climb, but they make the first wall much less dry.

Update: Verified the latest Arcade Basketball Codes on June 06, 2026

Arcade Basketball rewards clean timing, smart spacing, and a little bit of style. Codes will not fix a bad shot release, but they can give you crates, tickets, badge rolls, XP, coins, and limited cosmetics while you learn the court.

Below are the working Arcade Basketball codes, the rewards they give, and the quick steps to redeem them in Roblox.

All working Arcade Basketball codes

  • BIRTHDAY: 1x Limited Crate (NEW)
  • RNGEMOTE: 1x Limited Emote (NEW)
  • DUPING: 1x Limited Crate (NEW)
  • SRY: 1x Limited Crate
  • EXOTIC: 1x Limited Emote
  • PARK: 1x Limited Emote
  • SHRUG: 1x Limited Emote
  • TACOTIME: 1x Limited Crate
  • TEETIME: 1 Exclusive Shirt
  • ISO: 1 Green Effects Crate
  • NOOB: 1 Green Effects Crate
  • WAGER: 1 Green Effects Crate
  • MAYHEM: 10 Normal Tickets
  • NOSHIRT: 1 Lucky Badge Roll
  • SkeletorAngel: 500 XP
  • SOLOSEBEE: 250 coins
  • RANKED: 1x Limited Crate

Try these codes first. Copy them exactly as shown because Arcade Basketball codes can include mixed capitalization, numbers, and account requirements.

Some of these rewards are tied to following or the official Roblox group, so handle the requirements before assuming the code has expired.

Expired Arcade Basketball codes

10KLIKES, 4700LIKES!, 4P0, 5KLIKES, ANIMCRATE, BADGESPIN, BALLER, COINS, COOKIN, DANCEPARTY, DUNKEDON, FEELINGLUCKY, FREESPINS, FXCRATE, GETLUCKY, GREEN2, GROUP, KEYBINDS, LAUNCH, MORECRATES, RELEASE, SEASON5, SORRY, THANKS, VFXCRATE

How to redeem Arcade Basketball codes

Join the official community and like the game before redeeming codes. Some profile-based codes also need you to follow the matching Roblox user first.

  1. Open Arcade Basketball on Roblox.
  2. Join the Arcade Basketball Roblox group if you have not already.
  3. Launch the game and click Shop on the left side of the screen.
  4. Open the Codes tab.
  5. Paste or type a working code into the code box.
  6. Click Redeem to claim your reward.

If a follow-based code fails right after you follow the required profile, leave the experience and rejoin. Roblox sometimes needs a fresh session before the game recognizes the account check.

Why your Arcade Basketball code is not working

Start with the account requirements first. In Arcade Basketball, a valid code can still fail if the game cannot confirm your group join, game like, or profile follow.

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed the code with the wrong capitalization, an extra space, or a missing character.
  • You already redeemed the code on your Roblox account.
  • You have not joined the official group or liked the experience.
  • A follow-based code has not recognized your Roblox profile yet.
  • You are on an older server that has not synced the newest code.
  • Roblox or the Arcade Basketball server is having a temporary issue.

For mixed-case codes like “SkeletorAngel” Copy and paste instead of retyping. If a newly added code fails, try a fresh server before crossing it off.

Where to find more Arcade Basketball codes

Arcade Basketball codes usually appear around updates, patches, milestones, limited cosmetics, and community drops. These are the best places to check when you want new rewards early:

  • Arcade Basketball Roblox page
  • Arcade Basketball Roblox group
  • The game’s Discord server, especially if it has a dedicated codes or announcements channel

Discord is useful if you want to catch a code the moment it drops, but it is also the easiest place to lose time scrolling. You can bookmark this page if you prefer a cleaner working list. If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Basketball Zero codes, Basketball Legends codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

What is Arcade Basketball?

Arcade Basketball is a Roblox sports game by the Arcade Basketball group. It focuses on quick 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 matches, with player customization, balls, clothes, accessories, leaderboards, and a social hangout around the court.

Codes matter most if you care about cosmetics and progression between games. You still need timing and spacing to win, but free crates, XP, and coins make the early grind feel less dry.

Update: Verified the latest Jujutsu Randomizer codes on June 01, 2026

Jujutsu Randomizer throws you into fights with random cursed techniques, so Yen matters even when your moveset luck does not. Codes help you buy skins, finishers, and titles without grinding every reward through chaotic arena rounds.

Below are the Jujutsu Randomizer codes worth trying first, along with the rewards and the quick steps to redeem them in Roblox.

All working Jujutsu Randomizer codes

  • JANEJULIET: Free Rewards
  • 130KLIKES: Free Rewards
  • MASSGIRLBALANCE: Free Rewards
  • SUNNY: Free Rewards
  • MutualLove: 40 Technique Spins
  • Dessert: Free Technique Spins
  • Mahoraga: 30 Technique Spins
  • WUpd: 30 Technique Spins
  • Takaba: 20 Technique Spins
  • AlwaysBetOnHakari: 20 Clan Spins
  • Sorry: 20 Technique Spins
  • SkyManipulation: 20 Technique Spins
  • Cursed: 10 Technique Spins
  • SkillIssue: 3 Technique Spins

FINNALYANUPDATE, AURAMONSTER, and 8MVISITS are the newest codes in the current set, so redeem those first if you are short on time.

Expired Jujutsu Randomizer codes

5MILLIONSVISITSYAY, 6MILLIONSVISITSYAY, BLOODMANIPULATION, COLDUPDATE, COOLFIXES, COSMETICSPARTY, DELAYRANDOMIZER, DISASTERFLAMES, EGG, FRAMEGUYCOMEBACK, HANAMI, ILOVEOCEAN, INFINITY, JACKPOT, KADERPRIME, KINGOFCURSE, MAHORAGAHELPME!, NEWQUEST, SIMPLECODE, SIMPLEGUY, SIMPLEUPDATE, STORMWARRIOR, THANKSFORALLYOURSUPPORTS, THESTRONGESTOFTODAY, THX1MVISITS, THX25KLIKES, THX2MVISITS, THX50KLIKES, THXFORTHE100KLIKES, THXFORTHE25KMEMBERS, VIPFORSUKUNAHEHE, WATERISCOOL

How to redeem Jujutsu Randomizer codes

Jujutsu Randomizer asks you to join the developer’s Roblox community and like the game before the code box accepts rewards. Do that first so you do not waste time troubleshooting a valid code.

  1. Join the Dope Interactive Roblox community from the game’s Roblox page.
  2. Like Jujutsu Randomizer on Roblox.
  3. Launch the game.
  4. Click the Code icon on the left side of the screen.
  5. Paste or type a working code into the Insert Codes box.
  6. Press Enter or submit the code to claim your reward.

If the code box rejects everything, leave the experience and rejoin after checking the group and like requirements. Roblox games sometimes need a fresh session before account checks register properly.

Why is your Jujutsu Randomizer code not working

Start with the account requirements first. In Jujutsu Randomizer, a code can fail even when it is still active if the game does not see your group join or like yet.

  • The code has expired or moved out of the active pool.
  • You typed the wrong capitalization, missed a character, or added an extra space.
  • You have already redeemed the code on your Roblox account.
  • You have not joined the Dope Interactive community or liked the experience.
  • You are trying to use a VIP-only reward without VIP access.
  • You are on an older server that has not picked up the latest code changes.
  • Roblox or the Jujutsu Randomizer server is having a temporary issue.

For mixed or long codes like 6MILLIONSVISITSYAY and VIPFORSUKUNAHEHE, copying is safer than retyping. If a new code fails, try a fresh server before crossing it off.

Where to find more Jujutsu Randomizer codes

New Jujutsu Randomizer codes usually appear around updates, visit milestones, balance patches, and compensation drops. These are the best places to watch:

  • Dope Interactive Roblox community
  • Jujutsu Randomizer Discord server
  • @ashyboy_off on YouTube

The Discord and community page are useful for new drops, but the active list gets noisy when old codes linger across trackers. You can bookmark this page if you prefer a cleaner list focused on codes still worth trying.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Wizard Alchemy Codes, Build a Zoo Codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

What is Jujutsu Randomizer?

Jujutsu Randomizer is a Roblox arena fighter by Dope Interactive, where each round gives you random skills inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen. You fight other players, earn Yen, climb through titles, and spend rewards on skins or finishing moves.

Codes are most useful early, when you want cosmetics and finishers without relying only on match wins. They will not fix a bad roll in the arena, but they do make the lobby grind less stingy.

Update: Verified the latest Build A Zoo Codes on June 01, 2026

Build a Zoo codes are worth redeeming before you spend your early cash on random conveyor eggs. Free Eggs, Lucky Tickets, Diamonds, and cash can help you hatch better animals faster and push your zoo upgrades without waiting on slow income.

Below are the Build a Zoo codes worth trying first, along with the rewards and the quick redemption steps in Roblox.

All active Build a Zoo codes

  • MERRYTIMES2026: 500 Diamonds and 3 Lucky Tickets (NEW)
  • RABBITHAT30: 1 Sacred Deer Egg (NEW)
  • OCEANHEART0: x2 Ocean Heart (limited to 30,000 users)
  • FRIDAYGIFT5: 10 Tickets and 1 Pineapple
  • ZooFarmers: 800 Gems and 1 Pineapple
  • BLACKFRIDAY: Lucky Tickets
  • WAEX662ERC3: Lucky Tickets
  • 9WC77XXCM5A: Gems, Fruits, and Tickets
  • LandCompensation: 2000 Gems, 1 Dragon Fruit, and 3 Turkey Eggs
  • BHNR9CB9TNC: Gems, Fruits, and Tickets
  • A38JBJ3TSSE: Gems, Fruits, and Tickets
  • 9HDARHCQMWS: Gems, Fruits, and Tickets
  • N5HZKRRT2DF: Gems, Fruits, and Tickets
  • ZTWPH3WW8SJ: 5 Lucky Tickets and $20,000
  • ADQZP3MBW6N: 5 Lucky Tickets and $20,000
  • DS5523YSQ3C: 5 Lucky Tickets and $20,000
  • 3XKK8Z2WB6G: 5 Lucky Tickets and $20,000
  • N7A68Q82H83: 5 Lucky Tickets and $20,000
  • 4XW5RG4CHRY: 5 Lucky Tickets and $30,000
  • DelayGift: 1 Pet Egg and $20,000
  • 60KCCU919: 8 Lucky Tickets and $30,000
  • 50KCCU0912: 2 Pet Eggs and $20,000
  • ZooFish829: 1 Pet Egg and $20,000
  • FIXERROR819: 1 Pet Egg and $30,000
  • BugFixes: $30,000
  • U2CA518SC5: 1 Pet Egg
  • X2CA821BA3: 1 Pet Egg
  • 55PA21N8y2: 1 Pet Egg

Redeem the newer and limited-use codes first. Eggs matter more than they look early on because better animals can improve your cash flow and make later conveyor upgrades less painful.

Expired or unreliable Build a Zoo codes

ACORN251204, ADMINABUSE1, BUGFIX829, CE8CWQDFZSH, CFJXEH4M8K5, CHRISTMAS12, E5GSDBK7ATX, FIXTHEBUGS1, HOLIDAYFUN1, MAGICFRUIT, NA5Y874BAGG, ROMANCEBLOOMS, SANTAGIFT25, SANTASWORKS, SEASONONE, SURPRISEGIFT, TUESDAYFUN1, UPD18DINO, WEEKENDEVENT89, WEEKENDJOY5, XMASADVENT5

How to redeem Build a Zoo codes

The code box sits inside the Shop menu, but you may need to finish the short tutorial before every menu option becomes available.

  1. Open Build a Zoo on Roblox.
  2. Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Scroll down to the Redemption Code section.
  4. Paste or type a working code into the text box.
  5. Click Redeem to claim your rewards.

If you have just started playing, finish the opening tutorial first. Some players may not see or use the code section properly until the early setup is done.

Why is your Build a Zoo code not working

Most failed code attempts come down to the code being old, mistyped, or tied to a server that has not refreshed yet. Check these before giving up:

  • The code has expired or reached its redemption limit.
  • You typed the code with the wrong capitalization, a missing character, or an extra space.
  • You already redeemed the code on your Roblox account.
  • You are on an older server that has not received the newest code.
  • You have not finished enough of the tutorial to use the code box.
  • A future code may require joining a Roblox group or meeting a specific in-game condition.

For a new code that fails, close Build a Zoo and rejoin a fresh server. That is usually faster than repeatedly pasting the same code into an old server.

Where to find more Build a Zoo codes

New Build a Zoo codes usually appear around updates, milestones, bug fixes, events, and limited reward drops. These are the best places to check:

  • Build a Zoo Roblox page
  • Build a Zoo Discord
  • Century Farmers Roblox community

The Discord is useful if you want to catch codes as soon as they drop, but it can be messy when you only want the current rewards. You can also bookmark this page because we keep the active list focused on codes that are still worth trying.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Wizard Alchemy Codes, Roblox Ryujin codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

What is Build a Zoo?

Build a Zoo is a Roblox pet-collection and zoo-building game by Century Farmers. You hatch animals from eggs, earn cash from your collection, buy more eggs from the conveyor, and keep upgrading until your zoo starts printing better income.

Codes are useful because they skip some of the slowest early steps. A free rare egg or a few Lucky Tickets will not finish your zoo for you, but they can give you a much cleaner start before the grind gets expensive.

Update: Verified the latest Wizard Alchemy Codes on June 05, 2026

Wizard Alchemy codes are useful early because Race Rerolls can pull you out of weak starter rolls, while shards help with stronger potion paths later. Redeem the current codes before you spend too much time grinding ingredients and bosses with a bad setup.

Below are the working Wizard Alchemy codes, the rewards they give, and the quick steps to redeem them in Roblox.

All active Wizard Alchemy codes

  • 100KMEMBERS: 10 Race Rerolls (NEW)
  • QILIN: 500 Spirit Leaf (NEW)
  • MERCHANT: 2x EXP Potion (NEW)
  • DRUID: 5 Race Rerolls
  • SUMMON: 100 Spirit Leaf
  • 80KMEMBERS: 5 Enchanted Stones
  • 20kMembers: 5 Race Rerolls
  • BREW: 2x Fire, Ice, and Earth Shards
  • 17kCCU: 5 Race Rerolls
  • SPELL: 2x Dark and Light SHards

Try these codes first. Copy them exactly as shown, especially 17kCCU, because Roblox code boxes can be picky about numbers, capitalization, and extra spaces.

Expired Wizard Alchemy codes

40KCCU!, 60KMEMBERS!, BROOM, DELAY, NEWWORLD, RELEASE, UPDATE1!, WIZARD

How to redeem Wizard Alchemy codes

The code box sits inside the settings menu, so finish the opening tutorial first if the full UI is not available yet.

  1. Open Wizard Alchemy on Roblox.
  2. Click the gear icon in the top-right corner.
  3. Open the Utilities tab if the code box is not already visible.
  4. Paste or type a working code into the code box.
  5. Click Claim to receive your rewards.

Use your Race Rerolls carefully after redeeming the codes. If you land a strong rare race early, do not burn every reroll chasing a tiny upgrade unless you are ready for the gamble.

Why your Wizard Alchemy code is not working

Most failed code attempts come down to timing, typing, or server state. Check these before assuming the code is dead:

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed the code with a typo, wrong capitalization, extra space, or confused 0 with O.
  • You already redeemed the code on your Roblox account.
  • You are on an older server that has not received the newest code yet.
  • You have not completed enough of the tutorial to use the code menu properly.
  • Roblox or the Wizard Alchemy server is having a temporary issue.

If a new code fails, close the game and join a fresh server before crossing it off. Newly added Roblox codes can behave strangely on older servers for a short while.

Where to find more Wizard Alchemy codes

New Wizard Alchemy codes usually appear around updates, milestones, launch rewards, and community announcements. These are the best places to watch:

  • Wizard Alchemy Roblox page
  • Wizard Alchemy Discord

Discord is worth checking if you want codes the moment they drop, but it can be noisy if you only want rewards. You can also bookmark this page because we keep the active list focused on codes still worth trying.

If you want more free rewards, check out the Catch and Cook codes, Wheelie District codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

What is Wizard Alchemy?

Wizard Alchemy is a Roblox action RPG by Muggle Academy where you collect ingredients, brew potions, unlock spells, upgrade your power, and fight enemies across magical areas.

Codes matter early because Race Rerolls can change how your character scales before the grind gets heavier. Shard rewards are also worth claiming because potion elements become more important once you start pushing beyond the basic spell loop.

Missed This? Check It Out

  • Noob Tower Defense codes
  • Iron Soul Dungeon codes

Update: Verified the latest Catch And Cook Codes on June 01, 2026

Catch and Cook codes are worth redeeming early because Enchant Spins help you reroll your net enchantments. Better net rolls can make the fishing-and-cooking loop smoother, especially when you are trying to catch better ingredients, cook higher-value meals, and stack more Dabloons for upgrades.

Below are the working Catch and Cook codes, the rewards they give, and the quick steps to redeem them in Roblox.

All Active Catch and Cook codes

  • TOTEMPOWER: 3 Enchant Spins (NEW)
  • MILOSNACK: 3 Enchant Spins (NEW)
  • FREESPINS: 3 Enchant Spins
  • 1MIL: 3 Enchant Spins
  • MILOTHEORANGECAT: 3 Enchant Spins

These are the Catch and Cook codes worth trying first. Copy the codes exactly as shown; even if the game accepts different capitalization, exact spelling keeps you away from avoidable errors.

Expired Catch and Cook codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem Catch and Cook codes

The code menu is easy to miss because it sits in the main game UI, not inside a shop or settings page.

  1. Open Catch and Cook on Roblox.
  2. Click the Codes button in the top-right corner of the screen.
  3. Paste or type a working code into the text box.
  4. Click Claim to get your Enchant Spins.

No level, group, or premium requirement has surfaced for the current codes. If that changes with a future code, the game usually makes the requirement clear through its community channels.

Why your Catch and Cook code is not working

Most code errors come from a small mismatch between the code list and the server you are on. Start with these checks before assuming the code is dead:

  • The code has expired.
  • You typed the code with a spelling mistake, an extra space, or a wrong character.
  • The code system is treating letter case strictly, so copy the code exactly.
  • You have already redeemed the code on your Roblox account.
  • You are on an older server that has not picked up the latest code yet.
  • A future code may require joining a Roblox group or meeting a specific in-game condition.

If a new code fails, close Catch and Cook and rejoin from a fresh server. That often fixes newly added Roblox codes that do not work on older servers right away.

Where to find more Catch and Cook codes

Catch and Cook codes usually show up around updates, visit milestones, bug fixes, or community announcements. The best places to watch are:

  • Catch and Cook Roblox page
  • Catch and Cook Discord
  • Lotus Arts on X
  • Lotus Arts Games on YouTube

You can also bookmark this page because we keep the active list focused on codes that are still worth trying. For more Roblox rewards, check our All Roblox Game Codes hub or grab freebies from another creature-catching game with Roblox Go Catch codes.

What is Catch and Cook?

Catch and Cook is a Roblox fishing and cooking simulator by Lotus Green. You cast your net, cook what you catch, place meals to earn Dabloons, and spend those Dabloons on better nets and equipment.

The Roblox page says the game has more than 1,872,720 unique meal combinations, so Enchant Spins are useful because they help you improve the net side of the grind. Codes will not replace upgrades, but they do give you a cleaner start before the Dabloon loop gets expensive.

Missed This? Check It Out

  • Immortality Incremental code
  • Jujutsu Randomizer codes

Update: Verified the latest Wheelie District Codes on June 01, 2026

In Wheelie District, cash comes from holding wheelies, chaining combos, and keeping control long enough to build a multiplier. Free levels and boosts help early, especially before you have the bike or car setup you actually want.

Below are the working Wheelie District codes, the rewards they give, and the quick steps to redeem them in Roblox.

All Active Wheelie District codes

  • UPDATE3: Levels and free cash (NEW)
  • UPDATE2: 15 levels
  • QOL_0: Free Rewards (limited to 250 uses)
  • UPDATE1: Free XP

Try these codes first. QOL_0 It is a limited-use code, so it may stop working faster than normal update codes, even if you type it correctly.

Expired Wheelie District codes

PATCH1

How to redeem Wheelie District codes

Wheelie District requires you to join the developer’s Roblox group before code redemption works. Do that first, then claim the rewards from the in-game menu.

  1. Join the Wheelie District Studios Roblox group.
  2. Open Wheelie District on Roblox.
  3. Click Rewards in the top-left corner of the screen.
  4. Open the Codes tab.
  5. Paste or type a working code into the text box.
  6. Click Redeem to claim your reward.

If the game still asks you to join the group after you already did, close Roblox and rejoin Wheelie District. Group-based code checks sometimes need a fresh session before they recognize your account.

Why your Wheelie District code is not working

Start with the group requirement before assuming the code is dead. If you are already in the group, one of these issues is usually the reason:

  • The code has expired.
  • The code was limited to a small number of redemptions.
  • You typed the code with a typo, extra space, wrong letter case, or missed an underscore.
  • You already redeemed the code on your Roblox account.
  • You are on an older server that has not picked up the latest code.
  • Roblox or the game server is having a temporary issue.

For QOL_0 Copy the code exactly. The last character is zero, not the letter O, and the underscore matters. If a new code fails, join a different server and try again before crossing it off.

Where to find more Wheelie District codes

New Wheelie District codes usually arrive around updates, patches, bug fixes, and short community drops. The best places to watch are:

  • Wheelie District Roblox page
  • Wheelie District Studios Roblox group
  • nico_devss on X

The game’s Discord is also worth checking because some limited codes can appear in community channels and disappear quickly. You can also bookmark this page because we keep the working list focused on codes that are still worth trying. For more Roblox freebies, check our All Roblox Game Codes hub or grab general rewards from our Roblox promo codes list. If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Roblox Ryujin codes and Anime Rails Codes.

What is Wheelie District?

Wheelie District is a Roblox ride-out game by Wheelie District Studios. You pick bikes, scooters, mopeds, cars, and other vehicles, then earn cash by holding longer wheelies, building multipliers, and chaining clean combos.

Cash goes into unlocking better rides and improving your build, so codes are useful when you want to skip some early grind. They will not replace learning balance and throttle timing, but they do make the first upgrade less slow.

In case you missed

  • Build a Zoo codes
  • Wizard Alchemy codes
  • Catch and Cook codes

Update: Verified the latest Roblox Ryujin codes on June 01, 2026

Ryujin is a Roblox fighting RPG where progress depends on training, coins, and knowing where to spend your time. The early grind can feel slow, especially when you need cash and Ryujin Coins for upgrades, so redeeming codes is one of the quickest ways to get a useful head start.

Below are the working Ryujin codes, the rewards they give, and the steps to redeem them through the in-game phone.

All Active Ryujin codes

None

Use these codes exactly as shown. Ryujin codes can stop working without warning, so redeem the newest ones first if you are short on time.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Anime Rails codes, Tower Defense Simulator codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Ryujin codes

Currently, all available codes are valid and can be redeemed. Keep in mind that developers may remove them when new codes are issued, so it’s best to redeem them promptly.

How to redeem codes in Ryujin

Ryujin makes code redemption a little more involved than most Roblox games. You need to progress far enough to access the right in-game tools before the Codes app becomes useful.

  1. Open Ryujin on Roblox.
  2. Reach at least C Potential.
  3. Go to the Exchange area in the main lobby.
  4. Find the Ryujin Fighters Association.
  5. Buy an in-game phone for 50,000 Won.
  6. Open the phone and select the Codes app.
  7. Paste or type a working code into the text box.
  8. Press Confirm to claim your reward.

If you are new to Ryujin, do not worry if you cannot redeem codes immediately. Train and earn enough Won first, then come back to the Codes app once the phone is unlocked.

Why Ryujin code is not working

Most code errors come down to one of these issues:

  • The code has expired.
  • There is a typo, extra space, or wrong letter case.
  • You have already redeemed the code on your account.
  • You are on an older server that has not picked up the latest code yet.
  • You have not reached C Potential or bought the in-game phone.
  • The code has a hidden requirement, such as a group, update, or server condition.

Copying codes directly is the safest option. If a new code still fails, close Roblox, rejoin Ryujin on a fresh server, and try again.

Where to find more Ryujin codes

New Ryujin codes usually appear around updates, bug fixes, community milestones, and seasonal events. The best places to watch are the game’s official and community pages:

  • Ryujin Roblox page
  • Ryujin Discord
  • Ryujin Trello
  • Ryujin Wiki

You can also bookmark this page, since we keep code articles focused on the active list and remove expired rewards when they stop working. For more Roblox freebies, check our Roblox promo codes page or grab rewards from another PvP title with Dueling Grounds codes.

What is Ryujin?

Ryujin is a martial-arts-inspired Roblox experience by Martial Ascension. It focuses on PvP combat, stat training, fighting styles, and building a character strong enough to survive against other players.

The game also lets you adjust keybinds and mobile button layouts from settings, which is useful because combat timing matters a lot. Codes will not replace training, but they do make the grind easier by giving you extra Ryujin Coins and occasional utility rewards.

Missed This? Check It Out

  • Immortality Incremental code
  • Jujutsu Randomizer codes
  • Arcade Basketball codes

Update: Verified the latest Anime Rails Codes on June 01, 2026

Anime Rails takes the Dead Rails-style survival loop and gives it a full anime twist. You travel through dangerous wastelands, fight enemies inspired by popular anime, collect loot, and try to survive long enough to make real progress.

That sounds fun until your gear starts falling behind. Classes, skills, morphs, and auras all need Cash or rewards, and grinding for them can take time. That is where Anime Rails codes help. These codes give you free Cash and other rewards, so you can upgrade faster without starting every run empty-handed.

All Active Anime Rails codes

  • SAGE: 500 Cash (NEW)
  • 24MVISITS: 500 Cash (NEW)
  • SHIBUYA: Free Cash
  • RANDOMGEN: Free Cash
  • FULLSAMURAI: 500 Cash
  • S4PASS: Free Cash
  • 24FRAMES: Free Cash
  • APRIL1: Free Cash
  • LIGHTNING: Free Cash
  • MAPREWORK: Free Cash
  • ASSASSIN: Free Rewards
  • REGEN: Free Rewards
  • GATE: 400 Cash

Use these codes exactly as shown. Roblox codes are case-sensitive, so copy and paste them if possible to avoid small typing mistakes.

These rewards are useful early on because Cash lets you buy important upgrades instead of slowly grinding your way there. If you are new to Anime Rails, redeeming these codes before playing seriously can make your first few runs feel much less rough.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Anime Apocalypse codes, Tower Defense Simulator codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

Expired Anime Rails codes

1000CCU, 1000LIKES, 100LIKES, 10KLIKES, 10MVISITS, 11MVISITS, 12MVISITS, 13MVISITS, 14MVISITS, 1500LIKES, 15MVISITS, 16MVISITS, 1MVISITS, 1V1, 200LIKES, 20MVISITS, 2500LIKES, 2MVISITS, 3000CCU, 3MVISITS, 40KLIKES, 4MVISITS, 5000CCU, 500KMEMBER, 5MVISITS, 6MVISITS, 90KLIKES, 9MVISITS, ARISE, ATOMIC, AWAKEN, BATTLEROYAL, BLACKFLASH, BOSSRUSH, CHAINSAW, CHAKRA, CURSE, DBZ, DESTRUCTION, DISMANTLE, DRAGON1, EVENTSOON, FULLDRAGON, FUSION, GENERAL, GROUPBACK, HOLLOW, INFINITY, JJK, LEGENDARY, NARU, NEWHUB, NEWRAID, NIGHTMARE, ONEPUNCH, QUEST, RAIDSHOP, SABER, SKULL, SOON, SORRYFORBUG, THANKS, TIMESTOP, TITAN, TONY, TRI, ULTRAINSTINCT, WAVE, YEAR2026

How to redeem Anime Rails codes

Redeeming codes in Anime Rails is simple, but there is one extra step before the code box works. You need to join the Ghost Light Games Roblox Community first. You may also need to like the Anime Rails game from its Roblox page. Once that is done, follow these steps:

  1. Open Anime Rails on Roblox.
  2. Click the Codes button on the left side of the screen.
  3. Enter one working code into the text box.
  4. Click Redeem or press Enter to claim your reward.

If the code does not work, check the spelling first. Codes can fail if there is an extra space, a wrong capital letter, or a small typo. The safest option is to copy the code from the list and paste it directly into the game.

Why your Anime Rails code may not work

Most Anime Rails codes stop working because they expire without warning. Developers often release codes for milestones such as visits, likes, updates, or community member goals, but those codes do not always stay active for long.

A code can also fail if you have not joined the required Roblox group, if you already redeemed it, or if Roblox is having a temporary delay. If you are sure the code is typed correctly, restart the game and try again before assuming it has expired.

Where to find more Anime Rails codes

The easiest way to stay updated is to bookmark this page and check back often. Anime Rails codes can drop when the game gets a new update, reaches a new milestone, or receives a major content patch.

You can also join the official Anime Rails Discord server and watch the announcement and codes channels. Just keep in mind that developers sometimes post code in different places, so finding it manually can be annoying. A regularly updated list saves you from digging through Discord messages every time you want free Cash.

Anime Rails can feel tough when you are starting with basic gear, but a few free rewards can smooth out the early grind. Redeem the working codes, upgrade your setup, and you should have a better chance of surviving the wasteland instead of getting wiped before the run gets interesting.

In case you missed

  • Build a Zoo codes
  • Wizard Alchemy codes
  • Catch and Cook codes

title.rendered: The best GTA games to play on iOS and Android right now

content.rendered:
Contrary to what some people may think, several popular GTA games are officially available for iPhone and Android. In fact, some of the most iconic entries in Rockstar Games’ legendary franchise can now be played directly on mobile devices.

Thanks to mobile-friendly features like touch controls and controller support, these ports offer a surprisingly smooth way to experience GTA’s massive open worlds on the go. Combine that with the convenience of playing on a pocket-sized device, and mobile easily becomes one of the most accessible ways to enjoy high-speed chases, chaotic missions, and classic GTA action anywhere.

GTA games available on iOS and Android

From sprawling open worlds to iconic storylines, these are the best GTA games you can officially play on iPhone and Android right now.

1. GTA San Andreas — Definitive

There’s a reason GTA San Andreas still lives rent-free in the minds of so many gamers. The massive scale of San Andreas and the sheer amount of content packed into its world make it one of the most unforgettable games in the franchise.

You play as Carl Johnson, a former Grove Street Families member returning home during the 1990s. Alongside the main story, you can take part in countless side activities and minigames, including pool, arcade games, and gambling.

The game spans three major cities — Los Santos, San Fierro, and Las Venturas — and lets you travel using everything from BMX bikes to fighter jets. San Andreas also offers one of the deepest customization systems in GTA history, including barber shops, tattoo parlors, gyms, and vehicle modification garages.

Price: $19.99

Download: iPhone | Android

2. GTA Vice City — Definitive

There’s something timeless about GTA Vice City. Whenever players remember it, they usually picture glowing neon lights, pastel sunsets, and the unmistakable atmosphere of the 1980s.

Set in Vice City, Rockstar’s fictional version of Miami, the game follows Tommy Vercetti after a drug deal goes horribly wrong. As Tommy builds his criminal empire, you’ll encounter memorable allies, dangerous enemies, and one of the most stylish settings in gaming history.

The game’s iconic soundtrack, filled with classic ‘80s hits, perfectly complements its beaches, luxury mansions, private islands, and vibrant nightlife. Vice City remains one of the most atmospheric GTA games ever created.

Price: $19.99

Download: iPhone | Android

3. GTA 3 — Definitive

GTA 3 is more than just another entry in the series. It’s one of the most important games in video game history.

Released over two decades ago, GTA 3 helped redefine what open-world games could be. This Definitive Edition brings the classic experience to modern mobile devices with updated visuals and controls.

Set in Liberty City, Rockstar’s version of New York City, the game follows Claude as he climbs through the city’s dangerous criminal underworld by working for various gangs and mob bosses.

Unlike later GTA games, GTA 3 has a darker and more grounded atmosphere that still stands out today. While motorcycles are absent, the game still offers plenty of vehicles and freedom to explore its gritty urban world.

Price: $19.99

Download: iPhone | Android

4. GTA Liberty City Stories

GTA Liberty City Stories acts as a prequel to GTA 3 and takes place three years before its events. Unlike GTA 3, this game includes motorcycles and presents a slightly brighter version of Liberty City.

You play as Toni Cipriani, a loyal member of the Leone crime family navigating a city filled with gang wars, corruption, and power struggles.

For fans who enjoyed GTA 3 and want to explore more of Liberty City’s backstory, Liberty City Stories remains a great experience on mobile.

Price: $6.99

Download: iPhone | Android

5. GTA Chinatown Wars

GTA Chinatown Wars feels like a blend of classic top-down GTA gameplay and modern open-world design. It’s also one of Rockstar’s most experimental mobile titles.

You play as Huang Lee, a young Triad member navigating Liberty City’s criminal underworld after a family tragedy. Unlike many other GTA protagonists, Huang already has deep ties to organized crime from the beginning.

What makes Chinatown Wars especially unique is how well it uses touchscreen controls. Activities like hotwiring cars and crafting Molotov cocktails are integrated into interactive touch-based minigames, helping the game feel naturally designed for mobile devices.

Despite its smaller scale compared to other GTA entries, Chinatown Wars remains one of the most creative games in the franchise.

Price: $4.99

Download: iPhone | Android

Other Rockstar Games available on mobile

Beyond GTA, Rockstar Games has also brought several other major titles to iOS and Android.

Red Dead Redemption

Red Dead Redemption is essentially Rockstar’s open-world formula reimagined in a Western setting. Instead of fast cars and city streets, you get horses, dusty towns, and rugged frontier landscapes.

You play as John Marston, a former outlaw forced by the government to hunt down members of his old gang. The game’s emotional story and immersive world still hold up incredibly well today.

Bully: Anniversary Edition

Bully: Anniversary Edition swaps crime-filled cities for the chaotic halls of Bullworth Academy.

You play as Jimmy Hopkins, a rebellious teenager trying to survive a school filled with bullies, cliques, and bizarre teachers. The game includes classes, minigames, story missions, and plenty of Rockstar-style humor.

Since Jimmy is too young to drive, transportation mostly revolves around skateboards and bicycles.

Max Payne Mobile

Unlike GTA and Red Dead Redemption, Max Payne Mobile delivers a far more linear experience focused heavily on storytelling and action.

The game follows detective Max Payne as he seeks revenge after a devastating personal tragedy. Its iconic bullet-time shooting mechanics and dark noir-inspired atmosphere still feel impressive even years later.

Which GTA mobile game should you play?

Since these are ports of some of Rockstar’s most celebrated games, there really isn’t a bad choice here. However, if you want the most complete GTA experience on mobile, GTA San Andreas — Definitive is still the easiest recommendation.

Its massive world, huge amount of content, and unmatched customization options make it one of the best Rockstar games ever released, regardless of platform.

FAQs

Are GTA games natively playable on iPhone and Android?

Yes. Rockstar has officially released several GTA games for both iOS and Android over the years, including mainline entries and spin-offs.

Can I play GTA 5 on mobile?

There is currently no native mobile version of GTA 5. However, you can still play it on a smartphone through cloud gaming or by streaming it from a PC or console.

Can I use a controller to play GTA on mobile?

Yes. Most GTA mobile ports support external controllers for a more traditional gaming experience.
